5852.label: Joshua 1:1
5852.text: And it came about after the death of Moses the servant of Jehovah that Jehovah proceeded to say to Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses:

5853.label: Joshua 1:2
5853.text: “Moses my servant is dead; and now get up, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the sons of Israel.

5854.label: Joshua 1:3
5854.text: Every place upon which the sole of YOUR foot will tread, to YOU people I shall certainly give it, just as I promised to Moses.

5855.label: Joshua 1:4
5855.text: From the wilderness and this Lebʹa·non to the great river, the river Eu·phraʹtes, that is, all the land of the Hitʹtites, and to the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun YOUR territory will prove to be.

5856.label: Joshua 1:5
5856.text: Nobody will take a firm stand before you all the days of your life. Just as I proved to be with Moses I shall prove to be with you. I shall neither desert you nor leave you entirely.

5857.label: Joshua 1:6
5857.text: Be courageous and strong, for you are the one who will cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their forefathers to give to them.

5858.label: Joshua 1:7
5858.text: “Only be courageous and very strong to take care to do according to all the law that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn aside from it to the right or to the left, in order that you may act wisely everywhere you go.

5859.label: Joshua 1:8
5859.text: This book of the law should not depart from your mouth, and you must in an undertone read in it day and night, in order that you may take care to do according to all that is written in it; for then you will make your way successful and then you will act wisely.

5860.label: Joshua 1:9
5860.text: Have I not commanded you? Be courageous and strong. Do not suffer shock or be terrified, for Jehovah your God is with you wherever you go.”

5861.label: Joshua 1:10
5861.text: And Joshua proceeded to command the officers of the people, saying:

5862.label: Joshua 1:11
5862.text: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Get provisions ready for yourselves, because three days from now YOU are crossing this Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that Jehovah YOUR God is giving YOU to take possession of it.’”

5863.label: Joshua 1:12
5863.text: And to the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh Joshua said:

5864.label: Joshua 1:13
5864.text: “Let there be a remembering of the word that Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded YOU, saying, ‘Jehovah YOUR God is giving YOU rest and has given YOU this land.

5865.label: Joshua 1:14
5865.text: YOUR wives, YOUR little ones and YOUR livestock will dwell in the land that Moses has given YOU on this side of the Jordan; but YOU men will pass over in battle formation before YOUR brothers, all the valiant mighty men, and YOU must help them.

5866.label: Joshua 1:15
5866.text: First when Jehovah gives rest to YOUR brothers the same as to YOU and they also have taken possession of the land that Jehovah YOUR God is giving them, YOU must also return to the land of YOUR holding and take possession of it, the one that Moses the servant of Jehovah has given YOU on the side of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun.’”

5867.label: Joshua 1:16
5867.text: Accordingly they answered Joshua, saying: “All that you have commanded us we shall do, and wherever you may send us we shall go.

5868.label: Joshua 1:17
5868.text: As we listened to Moses in everything, so we shall listen to you. Only may Jehovah your God prove to be with you just as he proved to be with Moses.

5869.label: Joshua 1:18
5869.text: Any man that behaves rebelliously against your order and does not listen to your words in all that you may command him will be put to death. Only be courageous and strong.”

5870.label: Joshua 2:1
5870.text: Then Joshua the son of Nun sent two men out secretly from Shitʹtim as spies, saying: “Go, take a look at the land and Jerʹi·cho.” So they went and came to the house of a prostitute woman whose name was Raʹhab, and they took up lodging there.

5871.label: Joshua 2:2
5871.text: In time it was said to the king of Jerʹi·cho: “Look! Men from the sons of Israel have come in here tonight to search out the land.”

5872.label: Joshua 2:3
5872.text: At that the king of Jerʹi·cho sent to Raʹhab, saying: “Bring out the men that came to you, that have come into your house, for it is to search out all the land that they have come.”

5873.label: Joshua 2:4
5873.text: Meantime the woman took the two men and concealed them. And she proceeded to say: “Yes, the men did come to me, and I did not know from where they were.

5874.label: Joshua 2:5
5874.text: And it came about at the closing of the gate by dark that the men went out. I just do not know where the men have gone. Chase after them quickly, for YOU will overtake them.”

5875.label: Joshua 2:6
5875.text: (She, though, had taken them up to the roof, and she kept them out of sight among stalks of flax laid in rows for her upon the roof.)

5876.label: Joshua 2:7
5876.text: And the men chased after them in the direction of the Jordan at the fords, and they shut the gate immediately after those chasing after them had gone out.

5877.label: Joshua 2:8
5877.text: As for these, before they could lie down, she herself came up to them on the roof.

5878.label: Joshua 2:9
5878.text: And she went on to say to the men: “I do know that Jehovah will certainly give YOU the land, and that the fright of YOU has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land have become disheartened because of YOU.

5879.label: Joshua 2:10
5879.text: For we have heard how Jehovah dried up the waters of the Red Sea from before YOU when YOU came out of Egypt, and what YOU did to the two kings of the Amʹor·ites who were on the other side of the Jordan, namely, Siʹhon and Og, whom YOU devoted to destruction.

5880.label: Joshua 2:11
5880.text: When we got to hear it, then our hearts began to melt, and no spirit has arisen yet in anybody because of YOU, for Jehovah YOUR God is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.

5881.label: Joshua 2:12
5881.text: And now, please, swear to me by Jehovah that, because I have exercised loving-kindness toward YOU, YOU also will certainly exercise loving-kindness toward the household of my father, and YOU must give me a trustworthy sign.

5882.label: Joshua 2:13
5882.text: And YOU must preserve alive my father and my mother and my brothers and my sisters and all who belong to them, and YOU must deliver our souls from death.”

5883.label: Joshua 2:14
5883.text: At that the men said to her: “Our souls are to die instead of YOU people! If YOU will not tell about this matter of ours, it must also occur that when Jehovah gives us the land, we also shall certainly exercise loving-kindness and trustworthiness toward you.”

5884.label: Joshua 2:15
5884.text: After that she had them descend by a rope through the window, for her house was on a side of the wall, and it was on the wall that she was dwelling.

5885.label: Joshua 2:16
5885.text: And she proceeded to say to them: “Go to the mountainous region, that those in pursuit may not come in contact with YOU; and YOU must keep hid there three days, until those in pursuit have come back, and afterward YOU may go in YOUR own direction.”

5886.label: Joshua 2:17
5886.text: In turn the men said to her: “We are free from guilt respecting this oath of yours that you have made us swear.

5887.label: Joshua 2:18
5887.text: Look! We are coming into the land. This cord of scarlet thread you should tie in the window by which you have had us descend, and your father and your mother and your brothers and all the household of your father you should gather to yourself into the house.

5888.label: Joshua 2:19
5888.text: And it must occur that anyone who goes out of the doors of your house into the open, his blood will be upon his own head, and we shall be free from guilt; and everyone who continues with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads if a hand should come upon him.

5889.label: Joshua 2:20
5889.text: And if you should report this matter of ours, we shall also have become free from guilt respecting this oath of yours that you have made us swear.”

5890.label: Joshua 2:21
5890.text: To this she said: “According to YOUR words so let it be.” With that she sent them off, and they went their way. After that she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

5891.label: Joshua 2:22
5891.text: So they went and came to the mountainous region and kept dwelling there three days, until the pursuers had come back. Now the pursuers were looking for them on every road, and they did not find them.

5892.label: Joshua 2:23
5892.text: And the two men proceeded to descend again from the mountainous region and to cross over and come to Joshua the son of Nun, and they began to relate to him all the things that had happened to them.

5893.label: Joshua 2:24
5893.text: And they went on to say to Joshua: “Jehovah has given all the land into our hand. Consequently all the inhabitants of the land have also grown disheartened because of us.”

5894.label: Joshua 3:1
5894.text: Then Joshua got up early in the morning, and he and all the sons of Israel proceeded to pull away from Shitʹtim and to come as far as the Jordan; and they went spending the night there before they would cross.

5895.label: Joshua 3:2
5895.text: So it came about at the end of the three days that the officers proceeded to pass through the midst of the camp

5896.label: Joshua 3:3
5896.text: and to command the people, saying: “As soon as YOU see the ark of the covenant of Jehovah YOUR God, and the priests, the Levites, carrying it, then YOU yourselves will pull away from YOUR place, and YOU must follow it,

5897.label: Joshua 3:4
5897.text: —only let there prove to be a distance between YOU and it of about two thousand cubits by measure; do not get near to it—in order that YOU may know the way by which YOU should go, for YOU have not passed over on that way before.”

5898.label: Joshua 3:5
5898.text: Joshua now said to the people: “Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow Jehovah will do wonderful things in YOUR midst.”

5899.label: Joshua 3:6
5899.text: Then Joshua said to the priests: “Take up the ark of the covenant and pass before the people.” So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.

5900.label: Joshua 3:7
5900.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to Joshua: “This day I shall start to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, that they may know that just as I proved to be with Moses I shall prove to be with you.

5901.label: Joshua 3:8
5901.text: And you—you should command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘As soon as YOU have come as far as the edge of the waters of the Jordan, YOU should stand still in the Jordan.’”

5902.label: Joshua 3:9
5902.text: And Joshua went on to say to the sons of Israel: “Approach here and listen to the words of Jehovah YOUR God.”

5903.label: Joshua 3:10
5903.text: After that Joshua said: “By this YOU will know that a living God is in YOUR midst, and that he will without fail drive away from before YOU the Caʹnaan·ites and the Hitʹtites and the Hiʹvites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Girʹga·shites and the Amʹor·ites and the Jebʹu·sites.

5904.label: Joshua 3:11
5904.text: Look! The ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth is passing before YOU into the Jordan.

5905.label: Joshua 3:12
5905.text: And now take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man for each tribe.

5906.label: Joshua 3:13
5906.text: And it must occur that at the instant that the soles of the feet of the priests carrying the ark of Jehovah, the Lord of the whole earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, the waters descending from above, and they will stand still as one dam.”

5907.label: Joshua 3:14
5907.text: And it came about that when the people pulled away from their tents just before passing over the Jordan, with the priests carrying the ark of the covenant before the people,

5908.label: Joshua 3:15
5908.text: and at the instant that the carriers of the Ark came as far as the Jordan and the feet of the priests carrying the Ark were dipped in the edge of the waters (now the Jordan overflows all its banks all the days of harvest),

5909.label: Joshua 3:16
5909.text: then the waters descending from above began to stand still. They rose up as one dam very far away at Adam, the city at the side of Zarʹe·than, while those descending toward the sea of the Arʹa·bah, the Salt Sea, were exhausted. They were cut off, and the people passed over in front of Jerʹi·cho.

5910.label: Joshua 3:17
5910.text: Meanwhile the priests carrying the ark of Jehovah’s covenant kept standing immovable on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan as all Israel were passing over on dry ground, until the whole nation had completed passing over the Jordan.

5911.label: Joshua 4:1
5911.text: And it came about that as soon as the whole nation had completed passing over the Jordan, Jehovah proceeded to say to Joshua:

5912.label: Joshua 4:2
5912.text: “Take for yourselves twelve men from the people, one man from each tribe,

5913.label: Joshua 4:3
5913.text: and command them, saying, ‘Take up for yourselves from the very middle of the Jordan, from the place where the priests’ feet stood motionless, twelve stones, and YOU must carry them over with YOU and deposit them in the lodging place in which you will lodge tonight.’”

5914.label: Joshua 4:4
5914.text: So Joshua called twelve men whom he had appointed from the sons of Israel, one man from each tribe;

5915.label: Joshua 4:5
5915.text: and Joshua went on to say to them: “Pass ahead of the ark of Jehovah YOUR God to the middle of the Jordan, and lift up for yourselves each one a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

5916.label: Joshua 4:6
5916.text: in order that this may serve as a sign in YOUR midst. In case YOUR sons should ask in time to come, saying, ‘Why do you have these stones?’

5917.label: Joshua 4:7
5917.text: YOU must also say to them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off from before the ark of Jehovah’s covenant. When it passed through the Jordan the waters of the Jordan were cut off, and these stones must serve as a memorial to the sons of Israel to time indefinite.’”

5918.label: Joshua 4:8
5918.text: Accordingly the sons of Israel did so, just as Joshua had commanded, and they took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, just as Jehovah had stated to Joshua, to correspond with the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel; and they went taking them over with them to the lodging place and depositing them there.

5919.label: Joshua 4:9
5919.text: There were also twelve stones that Joshua set up in the middle of the Jordan on the standing place of the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, and they continue there until this day.

5920.label: Joshua 4:10
5920.text: And the priests carrying the Ark were standing in the middle of the Jordan until the whole matter had been completed that Jehovah had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua. All the while the people hurried up and passed over.

5921.label: Joshua 4:11
5921.text: And it came about that as soon as all the people had completed passing over, then the ark of Jehovah passed over, and the priests, before the people.

5922.label: Joshua 4:12
5922.text: And the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh proceeded to pass over in battle formation in the sight of the sons of Israel, just as Moses had stated to them.

5923.label: Joshua 4:13
5923.text: About forty thousand equipped for the army passed over before Jehovah for the war onto the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho.

5924.label: Joshua 4:14
5924.text: On that day Jehovah made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel, and they began to fear him just as they had feared Moses all the days of his life.

5926.label: Joshua 4:16
5926.text: “Command the priests carrying the ark of the testimony that they go up out of the Jordan.”

5927.label: Joshua 4:17
5927.text: So Joshua commanded the priests, saying: “Go up out of the Jordan.”

5928.label: Joshua 4:18
5928.text: And it came about that when the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came up out of the middle of the Jordan and the soles of the feet of the priests were drawn out onto the dry ground, then the waters of the Jordan began returning to their place and went overflowing all its banks as formerly.

5929.label: Joshua 4:19
5929.text: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month and took up camping at Gilʹgal on the eastern border of Jerʹi·cho.

5930.label: Joshua 4:20
5930.text: As for the twelve stones that they had taken out of the Jordan, Joshua set these up at Gilʹgal.

5931.label: Joshua 4:21
5931.text: And he went on to say to the sons of Israel: “When YOUR sons ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

5932.label: Joshua 4:22
5932.text: YOU must then let YOUR sons know, saying, ‘On the dry land it was that Israel passed over this Jordan,

5933.label: Joshua 4:23
5933.text: when Jehovah YOUR God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before them until they had passed over, just as Jehovah YOUR God had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up from before us until we had passed over;

5934.label: Joshua 4:24
5934.text: in order that all the peoples of the earth may know Jehovah’s hand, that it is strong; in order that YOU may indeed fear Jehovah YOUR God always.’”

5935.label: Joshua 5:1
5935.text: And it came about that as soon as all the kings of the Amʹor·ites, who were on the side of the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Caʹnaan·ites, who were by the sea, heard that Jehovah had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the sons of Israel until they had passed over, then their hearts began to melt, and there proved to be no spiritedness in them anymore because of the sons of Israel.

5936.label: Joshua 5:2
5936.text: At that particular time Jehovah said to Joshua: “Make for yourself flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel again, the second time.”

5937.label: Joshua 5:3
5937.text: Accordingly Joshua made flint knives for himself and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibʹe·ath-ha·arʹa·loth.

5938.label: Joshua 5:4
5938.text: And this was the reason why Joshua did the circumcising: all the people that came out of Egypt, the males, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the road when they were coming out of Egypt.

5939.label: Joshua 5:5
5939.text: For all the people who came out proved to be circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness on the road when they were coming out of Egypt they had not circumcised.

5940.label: Joshua 5:6
5940.text: For the sons of Israel had walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the nation of the men of war who came out of Egypt that did not listen to the voice of Jehovah had come to its finish, to whom Jehovah swore that he would never let them see the land that Jehovah had sworn to their forefathers to give to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

5941.label: Joshua 5:7
5941.text: And their sons he raised up instead of them. These Joshua circumcised, because they proved to be uncircumcised, for they had not circumcised them on the road.

5942.label: Joshua 5:8
5942.text: And it came about that when they had completed circumcising all the nation, they kept sitting in their place in the camp until they revived.

5943.label: Joshua 5:9
5943.text: Then Jehovah said to Joshua: “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off YOU.” So the name of that place came to be called Gilʹgal until this day.

5944.label: Joshua 5:10
5944.text: And the sons of Israel continued to camp in Gilʹgal, and they proceeded to carry out the passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, on the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho.

5945.label: Joshua 5:11
5945.text: And they began to eat some of the yield of the land the day after the passover, unfermented cakes and roasted grains, on this same day.

5946.label: Joshua 5:12
5946.text: Then the manna ceased on the following day when they had eaten some of the yield of the land, and manna did not occur anymore for the sons of Israel, and they began to eat some of the produce of the land of Caʹnaan in that year.

5947.label: Joshua 5:13
5947.text: And it came about when Joshua happened to be by Jerʹi·cho that he proceeded to raise his eyes and look, and there there was a man standing in front of him with his drawn sword in his hand. So Joshua walked up to him and said to him: “Are you for us or for our adversaries?”

5948.label: Joshua 5:14
5948.text: To this he said: “No, but I—as prince of the army of Jehovah I have now come.” With that Joshua fell on his face to the earth and prostrated himself and said to him: “What is my lord saying to his servant?”

5949.label: Joshua 5:15
5949.text: In turn the prince of the army of Jehovah said to Joshua: “Draw your sandals from off your feet, because the place on which you are standing is holy.” At once Joshua did so.

5950.label: Joshua 6:1
5950.text: Now Jerʹi·cho was tightly shut up because of the sons of Israel, no one going out and no one entering.

5951.label: Joshua 6:2
5951.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Joshua: “See, I have given Jerʹi·cho and its king, the valiant mighty men, into your hand.

5952.label: Joshua 6:3
5952.text: And all YOU men of war must march round the city, going round the city once. That is the way you should do for six days.

5953.label: Joshua 6:4
5953.text: And seven priests should carry seven rams’ horns, before the Ark, and on the seventh day YOU should march round the city seven times and the priests should blow the horns.

5954.label: Joshua 6:5
5954.text: And it must occur that when they sound with the horn of the ram, when YOU hear the sound of the horn, all the people should shout a great war cry; and the wall of the city must fall down flat, and the people must go up, each one straight before him.”

5955.label: Joshua 6:6
5955.text: Accordingly Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them: “Take up the ark of the covenant, and seven priests should carry seven rams’ horns before the ark of Jehovah.”

5956.label: Joshua 6:7
5956.text: And he went on to say to the people: “Pass on and march round the city, and the war-equipped force should pass on ahead of the ark of Jehovah.”

5957.label: Joshua 6:8
5957.text: So it came about just as Joshua said to the people; and seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before Jehovah passed on and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah was following them.

5958.label: Joshua 6:9
5958.text: And the war-equipped force was going ahead of the priests blowing the horns, while the rear guard was following the Ark with a continual blowing on the horns.

5959.label: Joshua 6:10
5959.text: Now Joshua had commanded the people, saying: “YOU must neither shout nor let YOUR voices be heard, and no word should come out of YOUR mouths until the day when I say to YOU, ‘Shout!’ Then YOU must shout.”

5960.label: Joshua 6:11
5960.text: And he had the ark of Jehovah go marching round the city, going round once, after which they went to the camp and stayed overnight in the camp.

5961.label: Joshua 6:12
5961.text: Then Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests went carrying the ark of Jehovah,

5962.label: Joshua 6:13
5962.text: and seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the ark of Jehovah were walking, continually blowing the horns, and the war-equipped force was walking ahead of them, while the rear guard was following the ark of Jehovah with a continual blowing on the horns.

5963.label: Joshua 6:14
5963.text: And they went marching round the city on the second day once, after which they returned to the camp. That was the way they did for six days.

5964.label: Joshua 6:15
5964.text: And it came about on the seventh day that they proceeded to get up early, as soon as the dawn ascended, and they went marching round the city in this manner seven times. Just on that day they marched round the city seven times.

5965.label: Joshua 6:16
5965.text: And it came about on the seventh time that the priests blew the horns, and Joshua proceeded to say to the people: “Shout; for Jehovah has given YOU the city.

5966.label: Joshua 6:17
5966.text: And the city must become a thing devoted to destruction; it with everything that is in it belongs to Jehovah. Only Raʹhab the prostitute may keep on living, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers whom we sent out.

5967.label: Joshua 6:18
5967.text: As for YOU people, only keep away from the thing devoted to destruction, for fear YOU may get a desire and YOU do take some of the thing devoted to destruction and do constitute the camp of Israel a thing devoted to destruction and bring ostracism upon it.

5968.label: Joshua 6:19
5968.text: But all the silver and the gold and the articles of copper and iron are something holy to Jehovah. Into the treasure of Jehovah it should go.”

5969.label: Joshua 6:20
5969.text: Then the people shouted, when they proceeded to blow the horns. And it came about that as soon as the people heard the sound of the horn and the people began to shout a great war cry, then the wall began to fall down flat. After that the people went up into the city, each one straight before him, and captured the city.

5970.label: Joshua 6:21
5970.text: And they went devoting all that was in the city, from man to woman, from young man to old man and to bull and sheep and ass, to destruction by the edge of the sword.

5971.label: Joshua 6:22
5971.text: And to the two men who had done the spying on the land, Joshua said: “Go into the house of the woman, the prostitute, and bring out of there the woman and all who belong to her, just as YOU have sworn to her.”

5972.label: Joshua 6:23
5972.text: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Raʹhab and her father and her mother and her brothers and all who belonged to her, yes, all her family relationship they brought out; and they proceeded to set them down outside the camp of Israel.

5973.label: Joshua 6:24
5973.text: And they burned the city with fire and everything that was in it. Only the silver and the gold and the articles of copper and iron they gave to the treasure of Jehovah’s house.

5974.label: Joshua 6:25
5974.text: And Raʹhab the prostitute and the household of her father and all who belonged to her, Joshua preserved alive; and she dwells in the midst of Israel down to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent out to spy on Jerʹi·cho.

5975.label: Joshua 6:26
5975.text: Then Joshua had an oath pronounced at that particular time, saying: “Cursed may the man be before Jehovah who gets up and does build this city, even Jerʹi·cho. At the forfeit of his firstborn let him lay the foundation of it, and at the forfeit of his youngest let him put up its doors.”

5976.label: Joshua 6:27
5976.text: So Jehovah proved to be with Joshua, and his fame came to be in all the earth.

5977.label: Joshua 7:1
5977.text: And the sons of Israel went committing an act of unfaithfulness respecting the thing devoted to destruction in that Aʹchan the son of Carʹmi, the son of Zabʹdi, the son of Zeʹrah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the thing devoted to destruction. At this Jehovah’s anger grew hot against the sons of Israel.

5978.label: Joshua 7:2
5978.text: Then Joshua sent men out from Jerʹi·cho to Aʹi, which is close by Beth-aʹven, to the east of Bethʹel, and said to them: “Go up and spy on the land.” Accordingly the men went up and spied on Aʹi.

5979.label: Joshua 7:3
5979.text: After that they returned to Joshua and said to him: “Let not all the people go up. Let about two thousand men or about three thousand men go up and strike Aʹi. Do not weary all the people with going there, for they are few.”

5980.label: Joshua 7:4
5980.text: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, but they took to flight before the men of Aʹi.

5981.label: Joshua 7:5
5981.text: And the men of Aʹi got to strike down about thirty-six men of them, and they went pursuing them from before the gate as far as Shebʹa·rim and continued striking them down on the descent. Consequently the heart of the people began to melt and became as water.

5982.label: Joshua 7:6
5982.text: At this Joshua ripped his mantles and fell upon his face to the earth before the ark of Jehovah until the evening, he and the older men of Israel, and they kept putting dust upon their heads.

5983.label: Joshua 7:7
5983.text: And Joshua went on to say: “Alas, Sovereign Lord Jehovah, why did you bring this people all the way across the Jordan, just to give us into the hand of the Amʹor·ites for them to destroy us? And if only we had taken it upon ourselves and continued dwelling on the other side of the Jordan!

5984.label: Joshua 7:8
5984.text: Excuse me, O Jehovah, but what can I say after Israel has turned his back before his enemies?

5985.label: Joshua 7:9
5985.text: And the Caʹnaan·ites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and they will certainly surround us and cut our name off from the earth; and what will you do for your great name?”

5986.label: Joshua 7:10
5986.text: In turn Jehovah said to Joshua: “Get up, you! Why is it that you are falling upon your face?

5987.label: Joshua 7:11
5987.text: Israel has sinned, and they have also overstepped my covenant that I laid as a command upon them; and they have also taken some of the thing devoted to destruction and have also stolen and also kept it secret and have also put it among their own articles.

5988.label: Joshua 7:12
5988.text: And the sons of Israel will not be able to rise up against their enemies. The back is what they will turn before their enemies, because they have become a thing devoted to destruction. I shall not prove to be with YOU again unless YOU annihilate the thing devoted to destruction out of YOUR midst.

5989.label: Joshua 7:13
5989.text: Get up! Sanctify the people, and you must say, ‘Sanctify yourselves tomorrow, for this is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said: “A thing devoted to destruction is in your midst, O Israel. You will not be able to rise up against your enemies until YOU people have removed the thing devoted to destruction from YOUR midst.

5990.label: Joshua 7:14
5990.text: And YOU must present yourselves in the morning, tribe by tribe, and it must occur that the tribe that Jehovah will pick will come near, family by family, and the family that Jehovah will pick will come near, household by household, and the household that Jehovah will pick will come near, able-bodied man by able-bodied man.

5991.label: Joshua 7:15
5991.text: And it must occur that the one picked with the thing devoted to destruction will be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has overstepped the covenant of Jehovah and because he has committed a disgraceful folly in Israel.”’”

5992.label: Joshua 7:16
5992.text: Then Joshua rose early in the morning and had Israel come near, tribe by tribe of it, and the tribe of Judah got to be picked.

5993.label: Joshua 7:17
5993.text: Next he had the families of Judah come near and picked the family of the Zeʹrah·ites, after which he had the family of the Zeʹrah·ites come near, able-bodied man by able-bodied man, and Zabʹdi got to be picked.

5994.label: Joshua 7:18
5994.text: Finally he had his household come near, able-bodied man by able-bodied man, and Aʹchan the son of Carʹmi, the son of Zabʹdi, the son of Zeʹrah, of the tribe of Judah, got to be picked.

5995.label: Joshua 7:19
5995.text: Then Joshua said to Aʹchan: “My son, render, please, glory to Jehovah the God of Israel and make confession to him, and tell me, please, What have you done? Do not hide it from me.”

5996.label: Joshua 7:20
5996.text: At this Aʹchan answered Joshua and said: “For a fact I—I have sinned against Jehovah the God of Israel, and this way and that way I have done.

5997.label: Joshua 7:21
5997.text: When I got to see among the spoil an official garment from Shiʹnar, a good-looking one, and two hundred shekels of silver and one gold bar, fifty shekels being its weight, then I wanted them, and I took them; and, look! they are hidden in the earth in the midst of my tent with the money underneath it.”

5998.label: Joshua 7:22
5998.text: At once Joshua sent messengers, and they went running to the tent, and, look! it was hidden in his tent with the money underneath it.

5999.label: Joshua 7:23
5999.text: So they took them from the midst of the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the sons of Israel and poured them out before Jehovah.

6000.label: Joshua 7:24
6000.text: Joshua, and all Israel with him, now took Aʹchan the son of Zeʹrah and the silver and the official garment and the bar of gold and his sons and his daughters and his bull and his ass and his flock and his tent and everything that was his and they brought them up to the low plain of Aʹchor.

6001.label: Joshua 7:25
6001.text: Then Joshua said: “Why have you brought ostracism upon us? Jehovah will bring ostracism upon you on this day.” With that all Israel went pelting him with stones, after which they burned them with fire. Thus they stoned them with stones.

6002.label: Joshua 7:26
6002.text: And they proceeded to raise up over him a big pile of stones, down to this day. At this Jehovah turned away from his hot anger. That is why the name of that place has been called Low Plain of Aʹchor, down to this day.

6003.label: Joshua 8:1
6003.text: Then Jehovah said to Joshua: “Do not be afraid or be terrified. Take with you all the people of war and get up, go up to Aʹi. See, I have given into your hand the king of Aʹi and his people and his city and his land.

6004.label: Joshua 8:2
6004.text: And you must do to Aʹi and to its king just as you did to Jerʹi·cho and its king. Only YOU people may plunder its spoil and its domestic animals for yourselves. Set an ambush of yours against the city at its rear.”

6005.label: Joshua 8:3
6005.text: Accordingly Joshua and all the people of war rose to go up to Aʹi, and Joshua proceeded to choose thirty thousand men, valiant mighty ones, and to send them off by night.

6006.label: Joshua 8:4
6006.text: And he went on to command them, saying: “See, YOU are lying in ambush against the city to the rear of the city. Do not go very far away from the city, and YOU must all of YOU hold yourselves in readiness.

6007.label: Joshua 8:5
6007.text: As for me and all the people who are with me, we shall go close to the city. And it must occur that, in case they should come out to meet us just as at the first, we must then flee before them.

6008.label: Joshua 8:6
6008.text: And they must come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are fleeing before us just as at the first.’ And we must flee before them.

6009.label: Joshua 8:7
6009.text: Then YOU—YOU will rise up from the ambush, and YOU must take possession of the city; and Jehovah YOUR God will certainly give it into YOUR hands.

6010.label: Joshua 8:8
6010.text: And it must occur that as soon as YOU have seized the city, YOU should set the city on fire. According to Jehovah’s word YOU should do. See, I have commanded YOU.”

6011.label: Joshua 8:9
6011.text: After that Joshua sent them out and they marched to the place of ambush and took up quarters between Bethʹel and Aʹi to the west of Aʹi, while Joshua kept lodging on that night in the midst of the people.

6012.label: Joshua 8:10
6012.text: Then Joshua rose up early in the morning and reviewed the people and went up, he and the older men of Israel, before the people to Aʹi.

6013.label: Joshua 8:11
6013.text: And all the people of war who were with him went up, that they might approach and get in front of the city, and they proceeded to camp to the north of Aʹi, with the valley between them and Aʹi.

6014.label: Joshua 8:12
6014.text: In the meantime he took about five thousand men and set them as an ambush between Bethʹel and Aʹi, to the west of the city.

6015.label: Joshua 8:13
6015.text: So the people set the main camp that was to the north of the city and the extreme rear of it that was to the west of the city, and Joshua proceeded to go during that night into the middle of the low plain.

6016.label: Joshua 8:14
6016.text: And it came about that, as soon as the king of Aʹi saw it, then the men of the city got in a hurry and rose up early and went out to meet Israel in battle, he and all his people, at the appointed time, before the desert plain. As for him, he did not know that there was an ambush against him to the rear of the city.

6017.label: Joshua 8:15
6017.text: When Joshua and all Israel suffered a blow before them, then they took to flight by the way of the wilderness.

6018.label: Joshua 8:16
6018.text: At that all the people who were in the city were called out to chase after them, and they went chasing after Joshua and got to be drawn away from the city.

6019.label: Joshua 8:17
6019.text: And there was not a man remaining in Aʹi and Bethʹel that did not go out after Israel, so that they left the city wide open and went chasing after Israel.

6020.label: Joshua 8:18
6020.text: Jehovah now said to Joshua: “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Aʹi, for into your hand I shall give it.” Accordingly Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.

6021.label: Joshua 8:19
6021.text: And the ambush rose up quickly from its place, and they began to run at the instant that he stretched out his hand, and they proceeded to enter the city and capture it. Then they hurried and set the city on fire.

6022.label: Joshua 8:20
6022.text: And the men of Aʹi began to turn back and look, and there the smoke of the city ascended to the heavens, and there proved to be no ability in them to flee this way or that. And the people that were fleeing to the wilderness turned upon the pursuers.

6023.label: Joshua 8:21
6023.text: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, and so they turned around and went striking the men of Aʹi down.

6024.label: Joshua 8:22
6024.text: And these others came out of the city to meet them, so that they got to be in between Israel, these on this side and those on that, and they went striking them down until there did not remain of them either a survivor or an escapee.

6025.label: Joshua 8:23
6025.text: And the king of Aʹi they caught alive and proceeded to bring him near to Joshua.

6026.label: Joshua 8:24
6026.text: And it came about that while Israel was finishing the killing of all the inhabitants of Aʹi in the field, in the wilderness in which they had pursued them, they kept falling, all of them, by the edge of the sword until they came to their end. After that all Israel returned to Aʹi and struck it with the edge of the sword.

6027.label: Joshua 8:25
6027.text: And all those who fell on that day, from man to woman, amounted to twelve thousand, all the people of Aʹi.

6028.label: Joshua 8:26
6028.text: And Joshua did not draw back his hand with which he stretched out the javelin until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Aʹi to destruction.

6029.label: Joshua 8:27
6029.text: Only the domestic animals and the spoil of that city Israel plundered for themselves, according to Jehovah’s word that he had laid in command upon Joshua.

6030.label: Joshua 8:28
6030.text: Then Joshua burned Aʹi and reduced it to an indefinitely lasting mound, as a desolation down to this day.

6031.label: Joshua 8:29
6031.text: And he hanged the king of Aʹi upon a stake until the evening time; and as the sun was about to set Joshua gave the command, and then they took his dead body down from the stake and pitched it at the entrance of the gate of the city and raised up a great pile of stones over him, down to this day.

6032.label: Joshua 8:30
6032.text: It was then that Joshua proceeded to build an altar to Jehovah the God of Israel, in Mount Eʹbal,

6033.label: Joshua 8:31
6033.text: just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: “An altar of whole stones, upon which no iron tool has been wielded”; and they went offering up burnt offerings upon it to Jehovah and sacrificing communion sacrifices.

6034.label: Joshua 8:32
6034.text: Then he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses that he had written before the sons of Israel.

6035.label: Joshua 8:33
6035.text: And all Israel and their older men and the officers and their judges were standing on this side and on that side of the Ark in front of the priests, the Levites, carrying the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, the alien resident as well as the native, one half of them in front of Mount Gerʹi·zim and the other half of them in front of Mount Eʹbal, (just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had commanded,) to bless the people of Israel first of all.

6036.label: Joshua 8:34
6036.text: And after this he read aloud all the words of the law, the blessing and the malediction, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

6037.label: Joshua 8:35
6037.text: There proved to be not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read aloud in front of all the congregation of Israel, together with the women and the little ones and the alien residents who walked in their midst.

6038.label: Joshua 9:1
6038.text: And it came about that as soon as all the kings who were on the side of the Jordan in the mountainous region and in the She·pheʹlah and along the whole coast of the Great Sea and in front of Lebʹa·non, the Hitʹtites and the Amʹor·ites, the Caʹnaan·ites, the Perʹiz·zites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites, heard of it,

6039.label: Joshua 9:2
6039.text: they began to assemble themselves all together to make war against Joshua and Israel unanimously.

6040.label: Joshua 9:3
6040.text: And the inhabitants of Gibʹe·on heard what Joshua had done to Jerʹi·cho and Aʹi.

6041.label: Joshua 9:4
6041.text: So they, even of their own accord, acted with shrewdness and went and stocked themselves with provisions and took worn-out sacks for their asses, and wine skin-bottles worn out and burst and tied up,

6042.label: Joshua 9:5
6042.text: and worn-out and patched sandals on their feet, and worn-out garments upon themselves, and all the bread of their provisions proved to be dry and crumby.

6043.label: Joshua 9:6
6043.text: Then they went to Joshua at the camp at Gilʹgal and said to him and the men of Israel: “It is from a distant land that we have come. And now CONCLUDE a covenant with us.”

6044.label: Joshua 9:7
6044.text: At this the men of Israel said to the Hiʹvites: “Perhaps it is in our vicinity that you are dwelling. So how could we conclude a covenant with you?”

6045.label: Joshua 9:8
6045.text: In turn they said to Joshua: “We are your servants.” Then Joshua said to them: “Who are YOU, and where do YOU come from?”

6046.label: Joshua 9:9
6046.text: At this they said to him: “It is from a very distant land that your servants have come in regard to the name of Jehovah your God, because we have heard of his fame and of all that he did in Egypt,

6047.label: Joshua 9:10
6047.text: and of all that he did to the two kings of the Amʹor·ites who were on the other side of the Jordan, namely, Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon and Og the king of Baʹshan, who was in Ashʹta·roth.

6048.label: Joshua 9:11
6048.text: Hence our older men and all the inhabitants of our land said this to us, ‘Take provisions in YOUR hands for the journey and go to meet them, and YOU must say to them: “We are YOUR servants. And now conclude a covenant with us.”’

6049.label: Joshua 9:12
6049.text: This bread of ours, it was hot when we took it as our provisions out of our houses on the day of our going out to come here to YOU, and now, look! it is dry and has become crumby.

6050.label: Joshua 9:13
6050.text: And these are the wine skin-bottles that we filled new, and, look! they have burst, and these garments and sandals of ours, they have worn out because of the great length of the journey.”

6051.label: Joshua 9:14
6051.text: Upon that the men took some of their provisions, and at the mouth of Jehovah they did not inquire.

6052.label: Joshua 9:15
6052.text: And Joshua went making peace with them and concluding a covenant with them to let them live, and so the chieftains of the assembly swore to them.

6053.label: Joshua 9:16
6053.text: And it came about that at the end of three days, after they had concluded a covenant with them, they got to hear that they were near to them and it was in their vicinity they were dwelling.

6054.label: Joshua 9:17
6054.text: Then the sons of Israel pulled out and came to their cities on the third day, and their cities were Gibʹe·on and Che·phiʹrah and Be·erʹoth and Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim.

6055.label: Joshua 9:18
6055.text: And the sons of Israel did not strike them, because the chieftains of the assembly had sworn to them by Jehovah the God of Israel. And all the assembly began to murmur against the chieftains.

6056.label: Joshua 9:19
6056.text: At this all the chieftains said to all the assembly: “We, for our part, have sworn to them by Jehovah the God of Israel, and now we are not allowed to hurt them.

6057.label: Joshua 9:20
6057.text: This is what we shall do to them while letting them live, that no indignation may come upon us over the oath that we have sworn to them.”

6058.label: Joshua 9:21
6058.text: So the chieftains said to them: “Let them live and let them become gatherers of wood and drawers of water for all the assembly, just as the chieftains have promised them.”

6059.label: Joshua 9:22
6059.text: Joshua now called them and spoke to them, saying: “Why did YOU trick us, saying, ‘We are very far away from YOU,’ whereas YOU are dwelling in our very midst?

6060.label: Joshua 9:23
6060.text: And now YOU are cursed people, and a slave’s position and being gatherers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God will never be cut off from YOU.”

6061.label: Joshua 9:24
6061.text: Then they answered Joshua and said: “It was because your servants were plainly told that Jehovah your God had commanded Moses his servant to give YOU all the land and to annihilate all the inhabitants of the land from before YOU, and we became very much afraid for our souls because of YOU. So we did this thing.

6062.label: Joshua 9:25
6062.text: And now here we are, in your hand. Just as it is good and right in your eyes to do to us, do.”

6063.label: Joshua 9:26
6063.text: And he proceeded to do so to them and to deliver them from the hand of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.

6064.label: Joshua 9:27
6064.text: Accordingly Joshua constituted them on that day gatherers of wood and drawers of water for the assembly and for Jehovah’s altar, down to this day, at the place that he should choose.

6065.label: Joshua 10:1
6065.text: And it came about that as soon as A·doʹni-zeʹdek the king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Aʹi and then devoted it to destruction, that just as he had done to Jerʹi·cho and its king, so he had done to Aʹi and its king, and that the inhabitants of Gibʹe·on had made peace with Israel and were continuing in their midst,

6066.label: Joshua 10:2
6066.text: he became very much afraid, because Gibʹe·on was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Aʹi, and all its men were mighty ones.

6067.label: Joshua 10:3
6067.text: Consequently A·doʹni-zeʹdek the king of Jerusalem sent to Hoʹham the king of Heʹbron and to Piʹram the king of Jarʹmuth and to Ja·phiʹa the king of Laʹchish and to Deʹbir the king of Egʹlon, saying,

6068.label: Joshua 10:4
6068.text: “Come up to me and help me and let us strike Gibʹe·on, because it has made peace with Joshua and the sons of Israel.”

6069.label: Joshua 10:5
6069.text: At this they gathered together and went on up, five kings of the Amʹor·ites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Heʹbron, the king of Jarʹmuth, the king of Laʹchish, the king of Egʹlon, these and all their camps, and they proceeded to camp against Gibʹe·on and to war against it.

6070.label: Joshua 10:6
6070.text: Upon that the men of Gibʹe·on sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilʹgal, saying: “Do not let your hand relax from your slaves. Come up to us quickly and do save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amʹor·ites inhabiting the mountainous region have collected together against us.”

6071.label: Joshua 10:7
6071.text: So Joshua went on up from Gilʹgal, he and all the people of war with him and all the valiant mighty men.

6072.label: Joshua 10:8
6072.text: Then Jehovah said to Joshua: “Do not be afraid of them, for into your hand I have given them. Not a man of them will stand against you.”

6073.label: Joshua 10:9
6073.text: And Joshua proceeded to come against them by surprise. All night long he had gone up from Gilʹgal.

6074.label: Joshua 10:10
6074.text: And Jehovah went throwing them into confusion before Israel, and they began to slay them with a great slaughter at Gibʹe·on and went pursuing them by way of the ascent of Beth-hoʹron and slaying them as far as A·zeʹkah and Mak·keʹdah.

6075.label: Joshua 10:11
6075.text: And it came about that while they were fleeing from before Israel and were on the descent of Beth-hoʹron, Jehovah hurled great stones from the heavens upon them as far as A·zeʹkah, so that they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword.

6076.label: Joshua 10:12
6076.text: It was then that Joshua proceeded to speak to Jehovah on the day of Jehovah’s abandoning the Amʹor·ites to the sons of Israel, and he went on to say before the eyes of Israel: “Sun, be motionless over Gibʹe·on, And, moon, over the low plain of Aiʹja·lon.”

6077.label: Joshua 10:13
6077.text: Accordingly the sun kept motionless, and the moon did stand still, until the nation could take vengeance on its enemies. Is it not written in the book of Jaʹshar? And the sun kept standing still in the middle of the heavens and did not hasten to set for about a whole day.

6078.label: Joshua 10:14
6078.text: And no day has proved to be like that one, either before it or after it, in that Jehovah listened to the voice of a man, for Jehovah himself was fighting for Israel.

6079.label: Joshua 10:15
6079.text: After that Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp at Gilʹgal.

6080.label: Joshua 10:16
6080.text: Meantime these five kings fled and went hiding themselves in the cave at Mak·keʹdah.

6081.label: Joshua 10:17
6081.text: Then the report was made to Joshua, saying: “The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Mak·keʹdah.”

6082.label: Joshua 10:18
6082.text: At that Joshua said: “ROLL great stones up to the mouth of the cave and assign men over it to guard them.

6083.label: Joshua 10:19
6083.text: As for YOU men, do not stand still. Chase after YOUR enemies, and YOU must strike them in the rear. Do not allow them to enter into their cities, for Jehovah YOUR God has given them into YOUR hands.”

6084.label: Joshua 10:20
6084.text: And it came about that as soon as Joshua and the sons of Israel had finished slaying them with a very great slaughter, until these came to their end, and those who did survive of them escaped and went entering into the fortified cities,

6085.label: Joshua 10:21
6085.text: all the people then began to return to the camp, to Joshua, at Mak·keʹdah in peace. Not a man moved his tongue eagerly against the sons of Israel.

6086.label: Joshua 10:22
6086.text: Then Joshua said: “OPEN the mouth of the cave and bring out these five kings from the cave to me.”

6087.label: Joshua 10:23
6087.text: At that they did so and brought out to him from the cave these five kings, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Heʹbron, the king of Jarʹmuth, the king of Laʹchish, the king of Egʹlon.

6088.label: Joshua 10:24
6088.text: And it came about that as soon as they had brought out these kings to Joshua, Joshua proceeded to call all the men of Israel and to say to the commanders of the men of war that had gone with him: “Come forward. Place YOUR feet on the back of the necks of these kings.” So they came forward and placed their feet on the back of their necks.

6089.label: Joshua 10:25
6089.text: And Joshua went on to say to them: “Do not be afraid or be terrified. Be courageous and strong, for it is like this that Jehovah will do to all YOUR enemies against whom YOU are warring.”

6090.label: Joshua 10:26
6090.text: And after that Joshua proceeded to strike them and put them to death and hang them upon five stakes, and they continued hanging upon the stakes until the evening.

6091.label: Joshua 10:27
6091.text: And it came about that at the time of the setting of the sun Joshua commanded, and they went taking them down off the stakes and throwing them into the cave where they had hid themselves. Then they placed big stones at the mouth of the cave—until this very day.

6092.label: Joshua 10:28
6092.text: And Joshua captured Mak·keʹdah on that day and went striking it with the edge of the sword. As for its king, he devoted him and every soul that was in it to destruction. He let no survivor remain. So he did to the king of Mak·keʹdah just as he had done to the king of Jerʹi·cho.

6093.label: Joshua 10:29
6093.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Mak·keʹdah to Libʹnah and warred against Libʹnah.

6094.label: Joshua 10:30
6094.text: Accordingly Jehovah gave it also and its king into Israel’s hand, and they went striking it and every soul that was in it with the edge of the sword. They did not let a survivor remain in it. So they did to its king just as they had done to the king of Jerʹi·cho.

6095.label: Joshua 10:31
6095.text: Next Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Libʹnah to Laʹchish and went camping against it and warring upon it.

6096.label: Joshua 10:32
6096.text: Accordingly Jehovah gave Laʹchish into Israel’s hand so that they captured it on the second day, and they went striking it and every soul that was in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that they had done to Libʹnah.

6097.label: Joshua 10:33
6097.text: It was then that Hoʹram the king of Geʹzer went up to help Laʹchish. So Joshua struck him and his people until he had let not a survivor of his remain.

6098.label: Joshua 10:34
6098.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Laʹchish to Egʹlon and went camping against it and warring against it.

6099.label: Joshua 10:35
6099.text: And they got to capture it on that day and began to smite it with the edge of the sword, and they devoted every soul that was in it to destruction on that day, according to all that they had done to Laʹchish.

6100.label: Joshua 10:36
6100.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Egʹlon to Heʹbron and began to war against it.

6101.label: Joshua 10:37
6101.text: And they got to capture it and went striking it and its king and all its towns and every soul that was in it with the edge of the sword. He did not let a survivor remain, according to all that he had done to Egʹlon. So he devoted it and every soul that was in it to destruction.

6102.label: Joshua 10:38
6102.text: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him came back to Deʹbir and began to war against it.

6103.label: Joshua 10:39
6103.text: And he got to capture it and its king and all its towns, and they went striking them with the edge of the sword and devoting every soul that was in it to destruction. He did not let a survivor remain. Just as he had done to Heʹbron, so he did to Deʹbir and its king, and just as he had done to Libʹnah and its king.

6104.label: Joshua 10:40
6104.text: And Joshua proceeded to strike all the land of the mountainous region and the Negʹeb and the She·pheʹlah and the slopes and all their kings. He did not let a survivor remain, and everything that breathed he devoted to destruction, just as Jehovah the God of Israel had commanded.

6105.label: Joshua 10:41
6105.text: And Joshua went striking them from Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a to Gaʹza and all the land of Goʹshen and up to Gibʹe·on.

6106.label: Joshua 10:42
6106.text: And Joshua captured all these kings and their land at one time, because it was Jehovah the God of Israel who was fighting for Israel.

6107.label: Joshua 10:43
6107.text: After that Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp at Gilʹgal.

6108.label: Joshua 11:1
6108.text: And it came about that as soon as Jaʹbin the king of Haʹzor heard of it, he went sending to Joʹbab the king of Maʹdon and to the king of Shimʹron and the king of Achʹshaph,

6109.label: Joshua 11:2
6109.text: and to the kings that were to the north in the mountainous region and in the desert plains south of Chinʹne·reth and in the She·pheʹlah and on the mountain ridges of Dor to the west,

6110.label: Joshua 11:3
6110.text: the Caʹnaan·ites to the east and the west, and the Amʹor·ites and the Hitʹtites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Jebʹu·sites in the mountainous region and the Hiʹvites at the base of Herʹmon in the land of Mizʹpah.

6111.label: Joshua 11:4
6111.text: So they went out, they and all their camps with them, a people as numerous as the grains of sand that are on the seashore for multitude, and very many horses and war chariots.

6112.label: Joshua 11:5
6112.text: Then all these kings met together by appointment and came and encamped together at the waters of Merʹom to fight against Israel.

6113.label: Joshua 11:6
6113.text: At this Jehovah said to Joshua: “Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I am abandoning all of them slain to Israel. Their horses you will hamstring, and their chariots you will burn in the fire.”

6114.label: Joshua 11:7
6114.text: And Joshua and all the people of war with him proceeded to come against them along the waters of Merʹom by surprise and to fall upon them.

6115.label: Joshua 11:8
6115.text: Then Jehovah gave them into Israel’s hand, and they went striking them and pursuing them as far as populous Siʹdon and Misʹre·photh-maʹim and the valley plain of Mizʹpeh to the east; and they kept striking them until they had not let a survivor of theirs remain.

6116.label: Joshua 11:9
6116.text: After that Joshua did to them just as Jehovah had said to him: their horses he hamstrung, and their chariots he burned in the fire.

6117.label: Joshua 11:10
6117.text: More than that, Joshua turned about at that time and captured Haʹzor; and its king he struck down with the sword, because Haʹzor was before that the head of all these kingdoms.

6118.label: Joshua 11:11
6118.text: And they went striking every soul that was in it with the edge of the sword, devoting [them] to destruction. No breathing thing at all was left over, and he burned Haʹzor in the fire.

6119.label: Joshua 11:12
6119.text: And all the cities of these kings and all their kings Joshua captured and went striking them with the edge of the sword. He devoted them to destruction, just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had commanded.

6120.label: Joshua 11:13
6120.text: It was only all the cities standing on their own mounds that Israel did not burn, except that Joshua did burn Haʹzor by itself.

6121.label: Joshua 11:14
6121.text: And all the spoil of these cities and the domestic animals the sons of Israel plundered for themselves. It was only all humankind that they struck with the edge of the sword until they had annihilated them. They did not let anyone that breathed remain.

6122.label: Joshua 11:15
6122.text: Just as Jehovah had commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did. He did not remove a word from all that Jehovah had commanded Moses.

6123.label: Joshua 11:16
6123.text: And Joshua proceeded to take all this land, the mountainous region and all the Negʹeb and all the land of Goʹshen and the She·pheʹlah and the Arʹa·bah and the mountainous region of Israel and its She·pheʹlah,

6124.label: Joshua 11:17
6124.text: from Mount Haʹlak, which goes up to Seʹir, and as far as Baʹal-gad in the valley plain of Lebʹa·non at the base of Mount Herʹmon, and he captured all their kings and went striking them and putting them to death.

6125.label: Joshua 11:18
6125.text: Many days it was that Joshua waged war with all these kings.

6126.label: Joshua 11:19
6126.text: There proved to be no city that made peace with the sons of Israel but the Hiʹvites inhabiting Gibʹe·on. All the others they took by war.

6127.label: Joshua 11:20
6127.text: For it proved to be Jehovah’s course to let their hearts become stubborn so as to declare war against Israel, in order that he might devote them to destruction, that they might come to have no favorable consideration, but in order that he might annihilate them, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

6128.label: Joshua 11:21
6128.text: Furthermore, at that particular time Joshua went and cut off the Anʹa·kim from the mountainous region, from Heʹbron, from Deʹbir, from Aʹnab and from all the mountainous region of Judah and from all the mountainous region of Israel. Along with their cities Joshua devoted them to destruction.

6129.label: Joshua 11:22
6129.text: No Anʹa·kim were left in the land of the sons of Israel. It was only in Gaʹza, in Gath and in Ashʹdod that they remained.

6130.label: Joshua 11:23
6130.text: So Joshua took all the land, according to all that Jehovah had promised Moses, and Joshua then gave it as an inheritance to Israel by their shares, according to their tribes. And the land had no disturbance from war.

6131.label: Joshua 12:1
6131.text: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel defeated and whose land they then took possession of on the side of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the torrent valley of Arʹnon up to Mount Herʹmon and all the Arʹa·bah toward the sunrise:

6132.label: Joshua 12:2
6132.text: Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who dwelt in Heshʹbon, ruling from A·roʹer, which was on the bank of the torrent valley of Arʹnon, and the middle of the torrent valley, and half of Gilʹe·ad as far as Jabʹbok the torrent valley, the boundary of the sons of Amʹmon,

6133.label: Joshua 12:3
6133.text: and the Arʹa·bah as far as the sea of Chinʹne·reth toward the east and as far as the sea of the Arʹa·bah, the Salt Sea, to the east in the direction of Beth-jeshʹi·moth, and toward the south under the slopes of Pisʹgah.

6134.label: Joshua 12:4
6134.text: And the territory of Og the king of Baʹshan, of what was left over of the Rephʹa·im, who dwelt in Ashʹta·roth and Edʹre·i,

6135.label: Joshua 12:5
6135.text: and who ruled in Mount Herʹmon and in Salʹe·cah and in all Baʹshan, as far as the boundary of the Geshʹur·ites and the Ma·acʹa·thites, and half of Gilʹe·ad, to the territory of Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon.

6136.label: Joshua 12:6
6136.text: It was Moses the servant of Jehovah and the sons of Israel who defeated them, after which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave it as a holding to the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and half of the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh.

6137.label: Joshua 12:7
6137.text: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the sons of Israel defeated on the side of the Jordan toward the west, from Baʹal-gad in the valley plain of Lebʹa·non and as far as Mount Haʹlak, which goes up to Seʹir, after which Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel as a holding by their shares,

6138.label: Joshua 12:8
6138.text: in the mountainous region and in the She·pheʹlah and in the Arʹa·bah and on the slopes and in the wilderness and in the Negʹeb —the Hitʹtites, the Amʹor·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites, the Perʹiz·zites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites:

6139.label: Joshua 12:9
6139.text: The king of Jerʹi·cho, one; the king of Aʹi, which was beside Bethʹel, one;

6140.label: Joshua 12:10
6140.text: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Heʹbron, one;

6141.label: Joshua 12:11
6141.text: the king of Jarʹmuth, one; the king of Laʹchish, one;

6142.label: Joshua 12:12
6142.text: the king of Egʹlon, one; the king of Geʹzer, one;

6143.label: Joshua 12:13
6143.text: the king of Deʹbir, one; the king of Geʹder, one;

6144.label: Joshua 12:14
6144.text: the king of Horʹmah, one; the king of Aʹrad, one;

6145.label: Joshua 12:15
6145.text: the king of Libʹnah, one; the king of A·dulʹlam, one;

6146.label: Joshua 12:16
6146.text: the king of Mak·keʹdah, one; the king of Bethʹel, one;

6147.label: Joshua 12:17
6147.text: the king of Tapʹpu·ah, one; the king of Heʹpher, one;

6148.label: Joshua 12:18
6148.text: the king of Aʹphek, one; the king of Las·sharʹon, one;

6149.label: Joshua 12:19
6149.text: the king of Maʹdon, one; the king of Haʹzor, one;

6150.label: Joshua 12:20
6150.text: the king of Shimʹron-meʹron, one; the king of Achʹshaph, one;

6151.label: Joshua 12:21
6151.text: the king of Taʹa·nach, one; the king of Me·gidʹdo, one;

6152.label: Joshua 12:22
6152.text: the king of Keʹdesh, one; the king of Jokʹne·am in Carʹmel, one;

6153.label: Joshua 12:23
6153.text: the king of Dor on the mountain ridge of Dor, one; the king of Goiʹim in Gilʹgal, one;

6154.label: Joshua 12:24
6154.text: the king of Tirʹzah, one;all the kings being thirty-one.

6155.label: Joshua 13:1
6155.text: Now Joshua was old, being advanced in years. So Jehovah said to him: “You yourself have grown old and have advanced in years, and to a very great extent the land yet remains to be taken in possession.

6156.label: Joshua 13:2
6156.text: This is the land yet remaining: all the regions of the Phi·lisʹtines and all the Geshʹur·ites

6157.label: Joshua 13:3
6157.text: (from the branch of the Nile that is in front of Egypt and up to the border of Ekʹron to the north, it used to be reckoned as belonging to the Caʹnaan·ites); five axis lords of the Phi·lisʹtines, the Gaʹzites and the Ashʹdod·ites, the Ashʹke·lon·ites, the Gitʹtites and the Ekʹron·ites; and the Avʹvim.

6158.label: Joshua 13:4
6158.text: To the south all the land of the Caʹnaan·ites; and Me·arʹah, which belongs to the Si·doʹni·ans, as far as Aʹphek, as far as the border of the Amʹor·ites;

6159.label: Joshua 13:5
6159.text: and the land of the Geʹbal·ites and all of Lebʹa·non toward the rising of the sun, from Baʹal-gad at the base of Mount Herʹmon as far as to the entering in of Haʹmath;

6160.label: Joshua 13:6
6160.text: all the inhabitants of the mountainous region, from Lebʹa·non to Misʹre·photh-maʹim, all the Si·doʹni·ans; I myself shall dispossess them from before the sons of Israel. Only make it fall to Israel as an inheritance, just as I have commanded you.

6161.label: Joshua 13:7
6161.text: And now apportion this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh.”

6162.label: Joshua 13:8
6162.text: With the other half tribe the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites took their inheritance that Moses gave them on the side of the Jordan toward the east, just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had given them,

6163.label: Joshua 13:9
6163.text: from A·roʹer, which is on the bank of the torrent valley of Arʹnon, and the city that is in the middle of the torrent valley, and all the tableland of Medʹe·ba as far as Diʹbon;

6164.label: Joshua 13:10
6164.text: and all the cities of Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who reigned in Heshʹbon, up to the border of the sons of Amʹmon;

6165.label: Joshua 13:11
6165.text: and Gilʹe·ad and the territory of the Geshʹur·ites and the Ma·acʹa·thites and all of Mount Herʹmon and all Baʹshan as far as Salʹe·cah;

6166.label: Joshua 13:12
6166.text: all the royal realm of Og in Baʹshan, who reigned in Ashʹta·roth and in Edʹre·i —he it was who remained of what was left of the Rephʹa·im —and Moses went striking them and dispossessing them.

6167.label: Joshua 13:13
6167.text: And the sons of Israel did not dispossess the Geshʹur·ites and the Ma·acʹa·thites, but Geshʹur and Maʹa·cath keep dwelling in the midst of Israel down to this day.

6168.label: Joshua 13:14
6168.text: It was only to the tribe of the Levites that he did not give an inheritance. The offerings made by fire of Jehovah the God of Israel are their inheritance, just as he has promised them.

6169.label: Joshua 13:15
6169.text: Then Moses made a gift to the tribe of the sons of Reuʹben by their families,

6170.label: Joshua 13:16
6170.text: and the territory came to be theirs from A·roʹer, which is on the bank of the torrent valley of Arʹnon, and the city that is in the middle of the torrent valley, and all the tableland by Medʹe·ba;

6171.label: Joshua 13:17
6171.text: Heshʹbon and all its towns that are on the tableland, Diʹbon and Baʹmoth-baʹal and Beth-baʹal-meʹon,

6172.label: Joshua 13:18
6172.text: and Jaʹhaz and Kedʹe·moth and Mephʹa·ath,

6173.label: Joshua 13:19
6173.text: and Kir·i·a·thaʹim and Sibʹmah and Zeʹreth-shaʹhar in the mountain of the low plain,

6174.label: Joshua 13:20
6174.text: and Beth-peʹor and the slopes of Pisʹgah and Beth-jeshʹi·moth,

6175.label: Joshua 13:21
6175.text: and all the cities of the tableland and all the royal realm of Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who reigned in Heshʹbon, and whom Moses struck, together with the chieftains of Midʹi·an, Eʹvi and Reʹkem and Zur and Hur and Reʹba, the dukes of Siʹhon, who were dwelling in the land.

6176.label: Joshua 13:22
6176.text: And Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor, the diviner, was one whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword along with their slain ones.

6177.label: Joshua 13:23
6177.text: And the boundary of the sons of Reuʹben came to be the Jordan; and this as a territory was the inheritance of the sons of Reuʹben by their families, with the cities and their settlements.

6178.label: Joshua 13:24
6178.text: Furthermore, Moses made a gift to the tribe of Gad, the sons of Gad by their families,

6179.label: Joshua 13:25
6179.text: and their territory came to be Jaʹzer and all the cities of Gilʹe·ad and half of the land of the sons of Amʹmon as far as A·roʹer, which is in front of Rabʹbah;

6180.label: Joshua 13:26
6180.text: and from Heshʹbon to Raʹmath-mizʹpeh and Betʹo·nim and from Ma·ha·naʹim to the border of Deʹbir;

6181.label: Joshua 13:27
6181.text: and in the low plain Beth-haʹram and Beth-nimʹrah and Sucʹcoth and Zaʹphon, the rest of the royal realm of Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon, the Jordan being the border as far as the extremity of the sea of Chinʹne·reth on the side of Jordan toward the east.

6182.label: Joshua 13:28
6182.text: This was the inheritance of the sons of Gad by their families, with the cities and their settlements.

6183.label: Joshua 13:29
6183.text: Further, Moses made a gift to the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, and it came to be that of the half tribe of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh by their families.

6184.label: Joshua 13:30
6184.text: And their territory came to be from Ma·ha·naʹim all of Baʹshan, all the royal realm of Og the king of Baʹshan, and all the tent villages of Jaʹir that are in Baʹshan, sixty towns.

6185.label: Joshua 13:31
6185.text: And half of Gilʹe·ad, and Ashʹta·roth and Edʹre·i, the cities of the royal realm of Og in Baʹshan, went to the sons of Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh, to half of the sons of Maʹchir by their families.

6186.label: Joshua 13:32
6186.text: These were what Moses caused [them] to inherit, on the desert plains of Moʹab on the side of the Jordan, at Jerʹi·cho, toward the east.

6187.label: Joshua 13:33
6187.text: And to the tribe of the Levites Moses did not give an inheritance. Jehovah the God of Israel is their inheritance, just as he has promised them.

6188.label: Joshua 14:1
6188.text: Now this is what the sons of Israel took as a hereditary possession in the land of Caʹnaan, which El·e·aʹzar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel caused them to inherit.

6189.label: Joshua 14:2
6189.text: Their inheritance was by lot, just as Jehovah had commanded by means of Moses for the nine tribes and the half tribe.

6190.label: Joshua 14:3
6190.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two other tribes and the other half tribe on the other side of the Jordan; and to the Levites he did not give an inheritance in their midst.

6191.label: Joshua 14:4
6191.text: For the sons of Joseph had become two tribes, Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im; and they had not given a share in the land to the Levites, except cities to dwell in and their pasture grounds for their livestock and their property.

6192.label: Joshua 14:5
6192.text: Just as Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did; and they proceeded to apportion the land.

6193.label: Joshua 14:6
6193.text: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua in Gilʹgal, and Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh the Kenʹiz·zite said to him: “You yourself well know the word that Jehovah spoke to Moses the man of the [true] God with regard to me and with regard to you at Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a.

6194.label: Joshua 14:7
6194.text: Forty years old I was when Moses the servant of Jehovah sent me out of Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a to spy out the land, and I came bringing him back word just as it was in my heart.

6195.label: Joshua 14:8
6195.text: And my brothers who went up with me caused the heart of the people to melt; but as for me, I followed Jehovah my God fully.

6196.label: Joshua 14:9
6196.text: Consequently Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘The land upon which your foot has trod will become yours and your sons’ as an inheritance to time indefinite, because you have followed Jehovah my God fully.’

6197.label: Joshua 14:10
6197.text: And now here Jehovah has preserved me alive, just as he promised, these forty-five years since Jehovah made this promise to Moses when Israel walked in the wilderness, and now here I am today eighty-five years old.

6198.label: Joshua 14:11
6198.text: Yet I am today as strong as on the day of Moses’ sending me out. As my power was then, so my power is now for the war, both to go out and to come in.

6199.label: Joshua 14:12
6199.text: And now do give me this mountainous region that Jehovah promised on that day, for you yourself heard on that day that there were Anʹa·kim there and great fortified cities. Likely Jehovah will be with me, and I shall certainly dispossess them, just as Jehovah promised.”

6200.label: Joshua 14:13
6200.text: At that Joshua blessed him and gave Heʹbron to Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh as an inheritance.

6201.label: Joshua 14:14
6201.text: That is why Heʹbron has come to belong to Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh the Kenʹiz·zite as an inheritance down to this day, for the reason that he followed Jehovah the God of Israel fully.

6202.label: Joshua 14:15
6202.text: The name of Heʹbron before that was Kirʹi·ath-arʹba ([said Arʹba was] the great man among the Anʹa·kim). And the land had no disturbance from war.

6203.label: Joshua 15:1
6203.text: And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their families came to be to the boundary of Eʹdom, the wilderness of Zin, to the Negʹeb at its southern end.

6204.label: Joshua 15:2
6204.text: And their southern boundary came to be from the extremity of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.

6205.label: Joshua 15:3
6205.text: And it went out southward to the ascent of A·krabʹbim and passed over to Zin and went up from the south to Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a and passed over to Hezʹron and went up to Adʹdar and went around to Karʹka.

6206.label: Joshua 15:4
6206.text: And it passed on to Azʹmon and went out to the torrent valley of Egypt; and the boundary’s termination proved to be at the sea. This came to be their southern boundary.

6207.label: Joshua 15:5
6207.text: And the eastern boundary was the Salt Sea up to the end of the Jordan, and the boundary at the northern corner was at the bay of the sea, at the end of the Jordan.

6208.label: Joshua 15:6
6208.text: And the boundary went up to Beth-hogʹlah and passed over at the north of Beth-arʹa·bah, and the boundary went up to the stone of Boʹhan the son of Reuʹben.

6209.label: Joshua 15:7
6209.text: And the boundary went up to Deʹbir at the low plain of Aʹchor and turning northward to Gilʹgal, which is in front of the ascent of A·dumʹmim, which is south of the torrent valley; and the boundary passed over to the waters of En-sheʹmesh, and its termination proved to be En-roʹgel.

6210.label: Joshua 15:8
6210.text: And the boundary went up to the valley of the son of Hinʹnom to the slope of the Jebʹu·site at the south, that is to say, Jerusalem; and the boundary went up to the top of the mountain that faces the valley of Hinʹnom to the west, which is at the extremity of the low plain of Rephʹa·im to the north.

6211.label: Joshua 15:9
6211.text: And the boundary was marked out from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Neph·toʹah, and went out to the cities of Mount Eʹphron; and the boundary was marked out to Baʹal·ah, that is to say, Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim.

6212.label: Joshua 15:10
6212.text: And the boundary went around from Baʹal·ah westward to Mount Seʹir and passed over to the slope of Mount Jeʹa·rim at the north, that is to say, Chesʹa·lon; and it went down to Beth-sheʹmesh and passed over to Timʹnah.

6213.label: Joshua 15:11
6213.text: And the boundary went out to the slope of Ekʹron to the north, and the boundary was marked out to Shikʹke·ron and passed over to Mount Baʹal·ah and went out to Jabʹne·el; and the boundary’s termination proved to be at the sea.

6214.label: Joshua 15:12
6214.text: And the western boundary was at the Great Sea and its shoreland. This was the boundary all around, of the sons of Judah by their families.

6215.label: Joshua 15:13
6215.text: And to Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh he gave a share in the midst of the sons of Judah at the order of Jehovah to Joshua, namely, Kirʹi·ath-arʹba ([said Arʹba being] the father of Aʹnak), that is to say, Heʹbron.

6216.label: Joshua 15:14
6216.text: So Caʹleb drove away from there the three sons of Aʹnak, namely, Sheʹshai and A·hiʹman and Talʹmai, those born of Aʹnak.

6217.label: Joshua 15:15
6217.text: Then he went up from there to the inhabitants of Deʹbir. (Now the name of Deʹbir before that was Kirʹi·ath-seʹpher.)

6218.label: Joshua 15:16
6218.text: And Caʹleb proceeded to say: “Whoever strikes Kirʹi·ath-seʹpher and does capture it, I shall certainly give him Achʹsah my daughter as a wife.”

6219.label: Joshua 15:17
6219.text: At that Othʹni·el the son of Keʹnaz, Caʹleb’s brother, captured it. Accordingly he gave him Achʹsah his daughter as a wife.

6220.label: Joshua 15:18
6220.text: And it came about that when she was going home, she kept inciting him to ask a field from her father. Then she clapped her hands while upon the ass. At this Caʹleb said to her: “What do you want?”

6221.label: Joshua 15:19
6221.text: So she said: “Do give me a blessing, for it is a piece of land to the south you have given me, and you must give me Gulʹloth-maʹim.” Accordingly he gave her Upper Gulʹloth and Lower Gulʹloth.

6222.label: Joshua 15:20
6222.text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their families.

6223.label: Joshua 15:21
6223.text: And the cities at the extremity of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the boundary of Eʹdom in the south came to be Kabʹze·el and Eʹder and Jaʹgur,

6224.label: Joshua 15:22
6224.text: and Kiʹnah and Di·moʹnah and A·daʹdah,

6225.label: Joshua 15:23
6225.text: and Keʹdesh and Haʹzor and Ithʹnan,

6227.label: Joshua 15:25
6227.text: and Haʹzor-ha·datʹtah and Keʹri·oth-hezʹron, that is to say, Haʹzor,
