6229.label: Joshua 15:27
6229.text: and Haʹzar-gadʹdah and Heshʹmon and Beth-pelʹet,

6230.label: Joshua 15:28
6230.text: and Haʹzar-shuʹal and Beʹer-sheʹba and Biz·i·o·thiʹah,

6232.label: Joshua 15:30
6232.text: and El·toʹlad and Cheʹsil and Horʹmah,

6233.label: Joshua 15:31
6233.text: and Zikʹlag and Mad·manʹnah and San·sanʹnah,

6234.label: Joshua 15:32
6234.text: and Le·baʹoth and Shilʹhim and Aʹin and Rimʹmon; all the cities being twenty-nine, together with their settlements.

6235.label: Joshua 15:33
6235.text: In the She·pheʹlah there were Eshʹta·ol and Zoʹrah and Ashʹnah,

6236.label: Joshua 15:34
6236.text: and Za·noʹah and En-ganʹnim, Tapʹpu·ah and Eʹnam,

6237.label: Joshua 15:35
6237.text: Jarʹmuth and A·dulʹlam, Soʹcoh and A·zeʹkah,

6238.label: Joshua 15:36
6238.text: and Shaʹa·raʹim and Ad·i·thaʹim and Ge·deʹrah and Ged·e·ro·thaʹim; fourteen cities and their settlements.

6240.label: Joshua 15:38
6240.text: and Diʹle·an and Mizʹpeh and Jokʹthe·el,

6242.label: Joshua 15:40
6242.text: and Cabʹbon and Lahʹmam and Chitʹlish,

6243.label: Joshua 15:41
6243.text: and Ge·deʹroth, Beth-daʹgon and Naʹa·mah and Mak·keʹdah; sixteen cities and their settlements.

6245.label: Joshua 15:43
6245.text: and Iphʹtah and Ashʹnah and Neʹzib,

6246.label: Joshua 15:44
6246.text: and Keiʹlah and Achʹzib and Ma·reʹshah; nine cities and their settlements.

6247.label: Joshua 15:45
6247.text: Ekʹron and its dependent towns and its settlements.

6248.label: Joshua 15:46
6248.text: From Ekʹron westward all that is alongside Ashʹdod and their settlements.

6249.label: Joshua 15:47
6249.text: Ashʹdod, its dependent towns and its settlements; Gaʹza, its dependent towns and its settlements, down to the torrent valley of Egypt, and the Great Sea and the adjacent region.

6250.label: Joshua 15:48
6250.text: And in the mountainous region Shaʹmir and Jatʹtir and Soʹcoh,

6251.label: Joshua 15:49
6251.text: and Danʹnah and Kirʹi·ath-sanʹnah, that is to say, Deʹbir,

6252.label: Joshua 15:50
6252.text: and Aʹnab and Eshʹte·moh and Aʹnim,

6253.label: Joshua 15:51
6253.text: and Goʹshen and Hoʹlon and Giʹloh; eleven cities and their settlements.

6255.label: Joshua 15:53
6255.text: and Jaʹnim and Beth-tapʹpu·ah and A·pheʹkah,

6256.label: Joshua 15:54
6256.text: and Humʹtah and Kirʹi·ath-arʹba, that is to say, Heʹbron, and Ziʹor; nine cities and their settlements.

6257.label: Joshua 15:55
6257.text: Maʹon, Carʹmel and Ziph and Jutʹtah,

6258.label: Joshua 15:56
6258.text: and Jezʹre·el and Jokʹde·am and Za·noʹah,

6259.label: Joshua 15:57
6259.text: Kaʹin, Gibʹe·ah and Timʹnah; ten cities and their settlements.

6261.label: Joshua 15:59
6261.text: and Maʹa·rath and Beth-aʹnoth and Elʹte·kon; six cities and their settlements.

6262.label: Joshua 15:60
6262.text: Kirʹi·ath-baʹal, that is to say, Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim, and Rabʹbah; two cities and their settlements.

6263.label: Joshua 15:61
6263.text: In the wilderness Beth-arʹa·bah, Midʹdin and Se·caʹcah,

6264.label: Joshua 15:62
6264.text: and Nibʹshan and the City of Salt and En-geʹdi; six cities and their settlements.

6265.label: Joshua 15:63
6265.text: As for the Jebʹu·sites who were dwelling in Jerusalem, the sons of Judah were not able to drive them away; and the Jebʹu·sites continue dwelling with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem down to this day.

6266.label: Joshua 16:1
6266.text: And the lot came out for the sons of Joseph from the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho to the waters of Jerʹi·cho eastward, the wilderness going up from Jerʹi·cho into the mountainous region of Bethʹel.

6267.label: Joshua 16:2
6267.text: And it went out from Bethʹel belonging to Luz and passed over to the boundary of the Arʹchites at Atʹa·roth,

6268.label: Joshua 16:3
6268.text: and it went down westward to the boundary of the Japhʹle·tites as far as the boundary of Lower Beth-hoʹron and Geʹzer, and its termination proved to be at the sea.

6269.label: Joshua 16:4
6269.text: And the sons of Joseph, Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im, proceeded to take possession of land.

6270.label: Joshua 16:5
6270.text: And the boundary of the sons of Eʹphra·im by their families came to be, yes, the boundary of their inheritance toward the east came to be Atʹa·roth-adʹdar, as far as Upper Beth-hoʹron;

6271.label: Joshua 16:6
6271.text: and the boundary went out to the sea. Mich·meʹthath was on the north, and the boundary went around eastward to Taʹa·nath-shiʹloh, and passed over eastward to Ja·noʹah.

6272.label: Joshua 16:7
6272.text: And it went down from Ja·noʹah to Atʹa·roth and Naʹa·rah and reached to Jerʹi·cho and went out to the Jordan.

6273.label: Joshua 16:8
6273.text: From Tapʹpu·ah the boundary moved on westward to the torrent valley of Kaʹnah, and its termination proved to be at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Eʹphra·im by their families.

6274.label: Joshua 16:9
6274.text: And the sons of Eʹphra·im had enclave cities in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh, all the cities and their settlements.

6275.label: Joshua 16:10
6275.text: And they did not drive away the Caʹnaan·ites who were dwelling in Geʹzer, and the Caʹnaan·ites continue dwelling in among Eʹphra·im down to this day and came to be subject to slavish forced labor.

6276.label: Joshua 17:1
6276.text: And the lot came to be for the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, because he was Joseph’s firstborn, for Maʹchir the firstborn of Ma·nasʹseh, the father of Gilʹe·ad, because he was one who proved to be a man of war; and Gilʹe·ad and Baʹshan came to belong to him.

6277.label: Joshua 17:2
6277.text: And there came to be [a lot] for the sons of Ma·nasʹseh who were left over according to their families, for the sons of Abi-eʹzer and the sons of Heʹlek and the sons of Asʹri·el and the sons of Sheʹchem and the sons of Heʹpher and the sons of She·miʹda. These were the sons of Ma·nasʹseh the son of Joseph, the males according to their families.

6278.label: Joshua 17:3
6278.text: As for Ze·loʹphe·had the son of Heʹpher, the son of Gilʹe·ad, the son of Maʹchir, the son of Ma·nasʹseh, he proved to have, not sons, but daughters, and these were the names of his daughters: Mahʹlah and Noah, Hogʹlah, Milʹcah and Tirʹzah.

6279.label: Joshua 17:4
6279.text: So they presented themselves before El·e·aʹzar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the chieftains, saying: “Jehovah it was who commanded Moses to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brothers.” Accordingly he gave them, at the order of Jehovah, an inheritance in the midst of the brothers of their father.

6280.label: Joshua 17:5
6280.text: And there were ten allotments falling to Ma·nasʹseh apart from the land of Gilʹe·ad and Baʹshan, which were on the other side of the Jordan;

6281.label: Joshua 17:6
6281.text: for the daughters of Ma·nasʹseh came into an inheritance in the midst of his sons; and the land of Gilʹe·ad became the property of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh who were left over.

6282.label: Joshua 17:7
6282.text: And the boundary of Ma·nasʹseh came to be from Ashʹer to Mich·meʹthath, which is in front of Sheʹchem, and the boundary moved to the right to the inhabitants of En-Tapʹpu·ah.

6283.label: Joshua 17:8
6283.text: The land of Tapʹpu·ah became Ma·nasʹseh’s, but Tapʹpu·ah at the boundary of Ma·nasʹseh belonged to the sons of Eʹphra·im.

6284.label: Joshua 17:9
6284.text: And the boundary went down to the torrent valley of Kaʹnah, southward to the torrent valley of these cities of Eʹphra·im in the midst of the cities of Ma·nasʹseh, and the boundary of Ma·nasʹseh was on the north of the torrent valley, and its termination came to be at the sea.

6285.label: Joshua 17:10
6285.text: To the south it was Eʹphra·im’s and to the north, Ma·nasʹseh’s, and the sea came to be his boundary; and on the north they reach to Ashʹer and on the east, to Isʹsa·char.

6286.label: Joshua 17:11
6286.text: And there came to belong to Ma·nasʹseh in Isʹsa·char and in Ashʹer Beth-sheʹan and its dependent towns and Ibʹle·am and its dependent towns and the inhabitants of Dor and its dependent towns and the inhabitants of En-dor and its dependent towns and the inhabitants of Taʹa·nach and its dependent towns and the inhabitants of Me·gidʹdo and its dependent towns, three of the heights.

6287.label: Joshua 17:12
6287.text: And the sons of Ma·nasʹseh did not prove able to take possession of these cities, but the Caʹnaan·ites persisted in dwelling in this land.

6288.label: Joshua 17:13
6288.text: And it turned out that when the sons of Israel had grown strong, they went putting the Caʹnaan·ites at forced labor, and they did not dispossess them entirely.

6289.label: Joshua 17:14
6289.text: And the sons of Joseph proceeded to speak with Joshua, saying: “Why is it that you have given me as an inheritance one lot and one allotment, whereas I am a numerous people for the reason that Jehovah has blessed me until now?”

6290.label: Joshua 17:15
6290.text: At this Joshua said to them: “If you are a numerous people, go your way up to the forest, and you must cut it down for yourself there in the land of the Perʹiz·zites and the Rephʹa·im, because the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im has become too narrow for you.”

6291.label: Joshua 17:16
6291.text: Then the sons of Joseph said: “The mountainous region is not enough for us, and there are war chariots with iron scythes among all the Caʹnaan·ites dwelling in the land of the low plain, both those who are in Beth-sheʹan and its dependent towns and those who are in the low plain of Jezʹre·el.”

6292.label: Joshua 17:17
6292.text: So Joshua said this to the house of Joseph, to Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh: “A numerous people you are, and great power is yours. You ought not to get one lot,

6293.label: Joshua 17:18
6293.text: but the mountainous region should become yours. Because it is a forest, you must cut it down, and it must become the termination point for you. For you should drive away the Caʹnaan·ites, although they have war chariots with iron scythes and they are strong.”

6294.label: Joshua 18:1
6294.text: Then all the assembly of the sons of Israel were congregated at Shiʹloh, and they proceeded to locate the tent of meeting there, as the land was now subdued before them.

6295.label: Joshua 18:2
6295.text: But there were still left among the sons of Israel those whose inheritance they had not apportioned out, namely, seven tribes.

6296.label: Joshua 18:3
6296.text: So Joshua said to the sons of Israel: “How long are YOU going to be delinquent about going in to take possession of the land that Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers has given YOU?

6297.label: Joshua 18:4
6297.text: Furnish for yourselves three men of each tribe and let me send them out, that they may get up and walk about in the land and map it out in accord with their inheritance, and let them come to me.

6298.label: Joshua 18:5
6298.text: And they must apportion it among themselves into seven shares. Judah will keep standing on his territory to the south, and the house of Joseph will keep standing on their territory to the north.

6299.label: Joshua 18:6
6299.text: As for YOU people, YOU will map out the land into seven shares, and YOU must bring them here to me, and I must cast lots here for YOU before Jehovah our God.

6300.label: Joshua 18:7
6300.text: For the Levites have no share in among YOU, because the priesthood of Jehovah is their inheritance; and Gad and Reuʹben and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh have taken their inheritance on the side of the Jordan toward the east, which Moses the servant of Jehovah has given them.”

6301.label: Joshua 18:8
6301.text: So the men got up that they might go, and Joshua proceeded to command those who were going to map out the land, saying: “Go and walk about in the land and map it out and return to me, and here is where I shall draw lots for YOU before Jehovah in Shiʹloh.”

6302.label: Joshua 18:9
6302.text: With that the men went and passed through the land and mapped it out by cities in seven shares, in a book. After that they came to Joshua at the camp in Shiʹloh,

6303.label: Joshua 18:10
6303.text: and Joshua went drawing lots for them in Shiʹloh before Jehovah. Thus Joshua there apportioned the land to the sons of Israel in their shares.

6304.label: Joshua 18:11
6304.text: Then the lot came up of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin by their families, and the territory of their lot went out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

6305.label: Joshua 18:12
6305.text: And their boundary came to be at the northern corner from the Jordan, and the boundary went up to the slope of Jerʹi·cho on the north and went up on the mountain westward, and its termination proved to be at the wilderness of Beth-aʹven.

6306.label: Joshua 18:13
6306.text: And the boundary passed over from there to Luz, at the southern slope of Luz, that is to say, Bethʹel; and the boundary went down to Atʹa·roth-adʹdar upon the mountain that is on the south of Lower Beth-hoʹron.

6307.label: Joshua 18:14
6307.text: And the boundary was marked out and went around at the western side to the south from the mountain that faces Beth-hoʹron to the south; and its termination proved to be at Kirʹi·ath-baʹal, that is to say, Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim, a city of the sons of Judah. This is the western side.

6308.label: Joshua 18:15
6308.text: And the side to the south was from the extremity of Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim, and the boundary went out westward and went out to the spring of the waters of Neph·toʹah.

6309.label: Joshua 18:16
6309.text: And the boundary went down to the extremity of the mountain that faces the valley of the son of Hinʹnom, which is in the low plain of Rephʹa·im to the north, and it went down to the valley of Hinʹnom, to the slope of the Jebʹu·site on the south, and went down to En-roʹgel.

6310.label: Joshua 18:17
6310.text: And it was marked out northward and went out to En-sheʹmesh and went out to Gel·iʹloth, which is in front of the ascent of A·dumʹmim; and it went down to the stone of Boʹhan the son of Reuʹben.

6311.label: Joshua 18:18
6311.text: And it passed over to the northern slope in front of the Arʹa·bah and went down to the Arʹa·bah.

6312.label: Joshua 18:19
6312.text: And the boundary passed over to the northern slope of Beth-hogʹlah, and the termination of it (the border) proved to be at the northern bay of the Salt Sea at the southern end of the Jordan. This was the southern boundary.

6313.label: Joshua 18:20
6313.text: And the Jordan served as its boundary on the eastern side. This was the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin by their families, by its boundaries all around.

6314.label: Joshua 18:21
6314.text: And the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin by their families proved to be Jerʹi·cho and Beth-hogʹlah and Eʹmek-keʹziz,

6315.label: Joshua 18:22
6315.text: and Beth-arʹa·bah and Zem·a·raʹim and Bethʹel,

6316.label: Joshua 18:23
6316.text: and Avʹvim and Paʹrah and Ophʹrah,

6317.label: Joshua 18:24
6317.text: and Cheʹphar-amʹmo·ni and Ophʹni and Geʹba; twelve cities and their settlements.

6319.label: Joshua 18:26
6319.text: and Mizʹpeh and Che·phiʹrah and Moʹzah,

6320.label: Joshua 18:27
6320.text: and Reʹkem and Irʹpe·el and Tarʹa·lah,

6321.label: Joshua 18:28
6321.text: and Zeʹlah, Ha-eʹleph and Je·buʹsi, that is to say, Jerusalem, Gibʹe·ah and Kirʹi·ath; fourteen cities and their settlements. This was the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin by their families.

6322.label: Joshua 19:1
6322.text: Then the second lot came out for Simʹe·on, for the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on by their families. And their inheritance came to be in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Judah.

6323.label: Joshua 19:2
6323.text: And they came to have in their inheritance Beʹer-sheʹba with Sheʹba, and Mo·laʹdah,

6324.label: Joshua 19:3
6324.text: and Haʹzar-shuʹal and Baʹlah and Eʹzem,

6325.label: Joshua 19:4
6325.text: and El·toʹlad and Beʹthul and Horʹmah,

6326.label: Joshua 19:5
6326.text: and Zikʹlag and Beth-marʹca·both and Haʹzar-suʹsah,

6327.label: Joshua 19:6
6327.text: and Beth-le·baʹoth and Sha·ruʹhen; thirteen cities and their settlements.

6328.label: Joshua 19:7
6328.text: Aʹin, Rimʹmon and Eʹther and Aʹshan; four cities and their settlements,

6329.label: Joshua 19:8
6329.text: and all the settlements that were all around these cities as far as Baʹal·ath-beʹer, Raʹmah of the south. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on by their families.

6330.label: Joshua 19:9
6330.text: The inheritance of the sons of Simʹe·on was out of the allotment of the sons of Judah, because the share of the sons of Judah proved to be too large for them. So the sons of Simʹe·on got a possession in the midst of their inheritance.

6331.label: Joshua 19:10
6331.text: Next the third lot came up for the sons of Zebʹu·lun by their families, and the boundary of their inheritance came to be as far as Saʹrid.

6332.label: Joshua 19:11
6332.text: And their boundary went up westward also to Marʹe·al and reached to Dabʹbe·sheth and reached to the torrent valley that is in front of Jokʹne·am.

6333.label: Joshua 19:12
6333.text: And it went back from Saʹrid eastward toward the rising of the sun to the border of Chisʹloth-taʹbor and went out to Dabʹe·rath and went up to Ja·phiʹa.

6334.label: Joshua 19:13
6334.text: And from there it passed over eastward toward the sunrise to Gath-heʹpher, to Eth-kaʹzin, and went out to Rimʹmon and was marked out to Neʹah.

6335.label: Joshua 19:14
6335.text: And the boundary went around it on the north to Hanʹna·thon, and its terminations proved to be at the valley of Iphʹtah-el,

6336.label: Joshua 19:15
6336.text: and Katʹtath and Na·halʹal and Shimʹron and Iʹda·lah and Bethʹle·hem; twelve cities and their settlements.

6337.label: Joshua 19:16
6337.text: This was the inheritance of the sons of Zebʹu·lun by their families. These were the cities and their settlements.

6338.label: Joshua 19:17
6338.text: It was for Isʹsa·char that the fourth lot came out, for the sons of Isʹsa·char by their families.

6339.label: Joshua 19:18
6339.text: And their boundary came to be to Jezʹre·el and Che·sulʹloth and Shuʹnem,

6340.label: Joshua 19:19
6340.text: and Haphʹa·raʹim and Shiʹon and An·a·haʹrath,

6341.label: Joshua 19:20
6341.text: and Rabʹbith and Kishʹi·on and Eʹbez,

6342.label: Joshua 19:21
6342.text: and Reʹmeth and En-ganʹnim and En-hadʹdah and Beth-pazʹzez.

6343.label: Joshua 19:22
6343.text: And the boundary reached to Taʹbor and Sha·ha·zuʹmah and Beth-sheʹmesh, and the terminations of their border proved to be at the Jordan; sixteen cities and their settlements.

6344.label: Joshua 19:23
6344.text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Isʹsa·char by their families, the cities and their settlements.

6345.label: Joshua 19:24
6345.text: Then the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Ashʹer by their families.

6346.label: Joshua 19:25
6346.text: And their boundary came to be Helʹkath and Haʹli and Beʹten and Achʹshaph,

6347.label: Joshua 19:26
6347.text: and Al·lamʹme·lech and Aʹmad and Miʹshal. And it reached westward to Carʹmel and to Shiʹhor-libʹnath,

6348.label: Joshua 19:27
6348.text: and it went back toward the rising of the sun to Beth-daʹgon and reached to Zebʹu·lun and the valley of Iphʹtah-el to the north, to Beth-eʹmek and Ne·iʹel, and it went out to Caʹbul on the left,

6349.label: Joshua 19:28
6349.text: and to Eʹbron and Reʹhob and Hamʹmon and Kaʹnah as far as populous Siʹdon.

6350.label: Joshua 19:29
6350.text: And the boundary went back to Raʹmah and as far as the fortified city of Tyre. And the boundary went back to Hoʹsah, and its terminations came to be at the sea in the region of Achʹzib,

6351.label: Joshua 19:30
6351.text: and Umʹmah and Aʹphek and Reʹhob; twenty-two cities and their settlements.

6352.label: Joshua 19:31
6352.text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ashʹer by their families. These were the cities and their settlements.

6353.label: Joshua 19:32
6353.text: It was for the sons of Naphʹta·li that the sixth lot came out, for the sons of Naphʹta·li by their families.

6354.label: Joshua 19:33
6354.text: And their boundary came to be from Heʹleph, from the big tree in Za·a·nanʹnim, and Adʹa·mi-neʹkeb and Jabʹne·el as far as Lakʹkum; and its terminations came to be at the Jordan.

6355.label: Joshua 19:34
6355.text: And the boundary went back westward to Azʹnoth-taʹbor and went out from there to Hukʹkok and reached to Zebʹu·lun on the south, and to Ashʹer it reached on the west and to Judah at the Jordan toward the rising of the sun.

6356.label: Joshua 19:35
6356.text: And the fortified cities were Zidʹdim, Zer and Hamʹmath, Rakʹkath and Chinʹne·reth,

6357.label: Joshua 19:36
6357.text: and Adʹa·mah and Raʹmah and Haʹzor,

6358.label: Joshua 19:37
6358.text: and Keʹdesh and Edʹre·i and En-haʹzor,

6359.label: Joshua 19:38
6359.text: and Yiʹron and Migʹdal-el, Hoʹrem and Beth-aʹnath and Beth-sheʹmesh; nineteen cities and their settlements.

6360.label: Joshua 19:39
6360.text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphʹta·li by their families, the cities and their settlements.

6361.label: Joshua 19:40
6361.text: It was for the tribe of the sons of Dan by their families that the seventh lot came out.

6362.label: Joshua 19:41
6362.text: And the border of their inheritance came to be Zoʹrah and Eshʹta·ol and Ir-sheʹmesh,

6363.label: Joshua 19:42
6363.text: and Sha·al·abʹbin and Aiʹja·lon and Ithʹlah,

6364.label: Joshua 19:43
6364.text: and Eʹlon and Timʹnah and Ekʹron,

6365.label: Joshua 19:44
6365.text: and Elʹte·keh and Gibʹbe·thon and Baʹal·ath,

6366.label: Joshua 19:45
6366.text: and Jeʹhud and Benʹe-beʹrak and Gath-rimʹmon,

6367.label: Joshua 19:46
6367.text: and Me-jarʹkon and Rakʹkon, with the border in front of Jopʹpa.

6368.label: Joshua 19:47
6368.text: And the territory of the sons of Dan was too cramped for them. And the sons of Dan proceeded to go up and war against Leʹshem and to capture it and strike it with the edge of the sword. Then they took possession of it and went dwelling in it, and they began to call Leʹshem Dan, according to the name of Dan their forefather.

6369.label: Joshua 19:48
6369.text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan by their families. These were the cities and their settlements.

6370.label: Joshua 19:49
6370.text: Thus they finished dividing the land for a possession by its territories. Then the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun in their midst.

6371.label: Joshua 19:50
6371.text: At the order of Jehovah they gave him the city for which he asked, namely, Timʹnath-seʹrah, in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im; and he began to build up the city and dwell in it.

6372.label: Joshua 19:51
6372.text: These were the inheritances that El·e·aʹzar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel distributed as a possession by lot in Shiʹloh before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they left off from apportioning the land.

6373.label: Joshua 20:1
6373.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Joshua, saying:

6374.label: Joshua 20:2
6374.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Give for yourselves the cities of refuge of which I spoke to YOU by means of Moses,

6375.label: Joshua 20:3
6375.text: for the manslayer who fatally strikes a soul unintentionally without knowing it to flee there; and they must serve YOU as a refuge from the avenger of blood.

6376.label: Joshua 20:4
6376.text: And he must flee to one of these cities and stand at the entrance of the gate of the city and speak his words in the hearing of the older men of that city; and they must receive him into the city to themselves and give him a place and he must dwell with them.

6377.label: Joshua 20:5
6377.text: And in case the avenger of blood chases after him, then they should not surrender the manslayer into his hand; for it was without knowing it that he struck his fellowman fatally, and he was not hating him formerly.

6378.label: Joshua 20:6
6378.text: And he must dwell in that city until his standing before the assembly for judgment, until the death of the high priest who happens to be in those days. It is then that the manslayer may return, and he must enter into his city and into his house, into the city from which he had fled.’”

6379.label: Joshua 20:7
6379.text: Accordingly they gave a sacred status to Keʹdesh in Galʹi·lee in the mountainous region of Naphʹta·li, and Sheʹchem in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, and Kirʹi·ath-arʹba, that is to say, Heʹbron, in the mountainous region of Judah.

6380.label: Joshua 20:8
6380.text: And in the region of the Jordan, at Jerʹi·cho, toward the east they gave Beʹzer in the wilderness on the tableland out of the tribe of Reuʹben, and Raʹmoth in Gilʹe·ad out of the tribe of Gad, and Goʹlan in Baʹshan out of the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh.

6381.label: Joshua 20:9
6381.text: These became the cities appointed for all the sons of Israel and for the alien resident who resides as an alien in their midst, for anyone to flee there who fatally strikes a soul unintentionally, that he may not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until his standing before the assembly.

6382.label: Joshua 21:1
6382.text: The heads of the fathers of the Levites now approached El·e·aʹzar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

6383.label: Joshua 21:2
6383.text: and they proceeded to speak to them in Shiʹloh in the land of Caʹnaan, saying: “Jehovah by means of Moses commanded cities to be given us in which to dwell, together with their pasture grounds for our domestic animals.”

6384.label: Joshua 21:3
6384.text: So the sons of Israel gave the Levites, at the order of Jehovah, these cities and their pasture grounds out of their inheritance.

6385.label: Joshua 21:4
6385.text: Then the lot came out for the families of the Koʹhath·ites, and thirteen cities came to belong to the sons of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, by lot, out of the tribe of Judah and out of the tribe of the Simʹe·on·ites and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

6386.label: Joshua 21:5
6386.text: And for the sons of Koʹhath that were left over there were by lot ten cities out of the families of the tribe of Eʹphra·im and out of the tribe of Dan and out of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh.

6387.label: Joshua 21:6
6387.text: And for the sons of Gerʹshon there were by lot thirteen cities out of the families of the tribe of Isʹsa·char and out of the tribe of Ashʹer and out of the tribe of Naphʹta·li and out of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh in Baʹshan.

6388.label: Joshua 21:7
6388.text: For the sons of Me·rarʹi by their families there were twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuʹben and out of the tribe of Gad and out of the tribe of Zebʹu·lun.

6389.label: Joshua 21:8
6389.text: Thus the sons of Israel gave the Levites these cities and their pasture grounds by lot, just as Jehovah had commanded by means of Moses.

6390.label: Joshua 21:9
6390.text: So out of the tribe of the sons of Judah and out of the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on they gave these cities that were called by name,

6391.label: Joshua 21:10
6391.text: and they came to belong to the sons of Aaron out of the families of the Koʹhath·ites of the sons of Leʹvi, because the first lot became theirs.

6392.label: Joshua 21:11
6392.text: Thus they gave them Kirʹi·ath-arʹba ([said Arʹba being] the father of Aʹnak), that is to say, Heʹbron, in the mountainous region of Judah, and its pasture ground all around it;

6393.label: Joshua 21:12
6393.text: and the field of the city and its settlements they gave to Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh as his possession.

6394.label: Joshua 21:13
6394.text: And to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave the city of refuge for the manslayer, namely, Heʹbron, and its pasture ground, also Libʹnah and its pasture ground,

6395.label: Joshua 21:14
6395.text: and Jatʹtir and its pasture ground, and Esh·te·moʹa and its pasture ground,

6396.label: Joshua 21:15
6396.text: and Hoʹlon and its pasture ground, and Deʹbir and its pasture ground,

6397.label: Joshua 21:16
6397.text: and Aʹin and its pasture ground, and Jutʹtah and its pasture ground, Beth-sheʹmesh and its pasture ground; nine cities out of these two tribes.

6398.label: Joshua 21:17
6398.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibʹe·on and its pasture ground, Geʹba and its pasture ground,

6399.label: Joshua 21:18
6399.text: Anʹa·thoth and its pasture ground, and Alʹmon and its pasture ground; four cities.

6400.label: Joshua 21:19
6400.text: All the cities of the sons of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities and their pasture grounds.

6401.label: Joshua 21:20
6401.text: And for the families of the sons of Koʹhath, the Levites who were left over of the sons of Koʹhath, there came to be by their lot cities out of the tribe of Eʹphra·im.

6402.label: Joshua 21:21
6402.text: Accordingly they gave them the city of refuge for the manslayer, namely, Sheʹchem, and its pasture ground in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, and Geʹzer and its pasture ground,

6403.label: Joshua 21:22
6403.text: and Kibʹza·im and its pasture ground, and Beth-hoʹron and its pasture ground; four cities.

6404.label: Joshua 21:23
6404.text: And from the tribe of Dan, Elʹte·ke and its pasture ground, Gibʹbe·thon and its pasture ground,

6405.label: Joshua 21:24
6405.text: Aiʹja·lon and its pasture ground, Gath-rimʹmon and its pasture ground; four cities.

6406.label: Joshua 21:25
6406.text: And from the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, Taʹa·nach and its pasture ground, and Gath-rimʹmon and its pasture ground; two cities.

6407.label: Joshua 21:26
6407.text: All the cities together with their pasture grounds that the families of the sons of Koʹhath who were left over had were ten.

6408.label: Joshua 21:27
6408.text: And for the sons of Gerʹshon, of the families of the Levites, there was out of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh the city of refuge for the manslayer, namely, Goʹlan, in Baʹshan, and its pasture ground, and Be·eshʹte·rah and its pasture ground; two cities.

6409.label: Joshua 21:28
6409.text: And out of the tribe of Isʹsa·char, Kishʹi·on and its pasture ground, Dabʹe·rath and its pasture ground,

6410.label: Joshua 21:29
6410.text: Jarʹmuth and its pasture ground, En-ganʹnim and its pasture ground; four cities.

6411.label: Joshua 21:30
6411.text: And out of the tribe of Ashʹer, Miʹshal and its pasture ground, Abʹdon and its pasture ground,

6412.label: Joshua 21:31
6412.text: Helʹkath and its pasture ground, and Reʹhob and its pasture ground; four cities.

6413.label: Joshua 21:32
6413.text: And out of the tribe of Naphʹta·li, the city of refuge for the manslayer, namely, Keʹdesh in Galʹi·lee, and its pasture ground, and Hamʹmoth-dor and its pasture ground, and Karʹtan and its pasture ground; three cities.

6414.label: Joshua 21:33
6414.text: All the cities of the Gerʹshon·ites by their families were thirteen cities and their pasture grounds.

6415.label: Joshua 21:34
6415.text: And the families of the sons of Me·rarʹi, the Levites who were left over, had out of the tribe of Zebʹu·lun Jokʹne·am and its pasture ground, Karʹtah and its pasture ground,

6416.label: Joshua 21:35
6416.text: Dimʹnah and its pasture ground, Na·halʹal and its pasture ground; four cities.

6417.label: Joshua 21:36
6417.text: And out of the tribe of Reuʹben, Beʹzer and its pasture ground, and Jaʹhaz and its pasture ground,

6418.label: Joshua 21:37
6418.text: Kedʹe·moth and its pasture ground, and Mephʹa·ath and its pasture ground; four cities.

6419.label: Joshua 21:38
6419.text: And out of the tribe of Gad, the city of refuge for the manslayer, namely, Raʹmoth in Gilʹe·ad, and its pasture ground, and Ma·ha·naʹim and its pasture ground,

6420.label: Joshua 21:39
6420.text: Heshʹbon and its pasture ground, Jaʹzer and its pasture ground; all the cities being four.

6421.label: Joshua 21:40
6421.text: All the cities that came to belong to the sons of Me·rarʹi by their families, who were left over from the families of the Levites, were, as their lot, twelve cities.

6422.label: Joshua 21:41
6422.text: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities together with their pasture grounds.

6423.label: Joshua 21:42
6423.text: These cities came to be each a city together with its pasture ground all around it—thus as to all these cities.

6424.label: Joshua 21:43
6424.text: So Jehovah gave Israel all the land that he had sworn to give to their forefathers, and they proceeded to take possession of it and to dwell in it.

6425.label: Joshua 21:44
6425.text: Furthermore, Jehovah gave them rest all around, according to everything that he had sworn to their forefathers, and not one of all their enemies stood before them. All their enemies Jehovah gave into their hand.

6426.label: Joshua 21:45
6426.text: Not a promise failed out of all the good promise that Jehovah had made to the house of Israel; it all came true.

6427.label: Joshua 22:1
6427.text: At that time Joshua proceeded to call the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh

6428.label: Joshua 22:2
6428.text: and to say to them: “For YOUR part, YOU have kept all that Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded YOU, and YOU were obedient to my voice in all that I have commanded YOU.

6429.label: Joshua 22:3
6429.text: YOU have not left YOUR brothers these many days down to this day, and YOU have kept the obligation of the commandment of Jehovah YOUR God.

6430.label: Joshua 22:4
6430.text: And now Jehovah YOUR God has given YOUR brothers rest, just as he promised them. So now turn and go YOUR way to YOUR tents in the land of YOUR possession, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave YOU on the other side of the Jordan.

6431.label: Joshua 22:5
6431.text: Only be very careful to carry out the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded YOU by loving Jehovah YOUR God and by walking in all his ways and by keeping his commandments and by cleaving to him and by serving him with all YOUR heart and with all YOUR soul.”

6432.label: Joshua 22:6
6432.text: With that Joshua blessed them and sent them away that they might go to their tents.

6433.label: Joshua 22:7
6433.text: And to the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh Moses had made a gift in Baʹshan, and to the other half of it Joshua made a gift with their brothers on the side of the Jordan to the west. So, too, when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he proceeded to bless them.

6434.label: Joshua 22:8
6434.text: And he went on to say to them: “Return to YOUR tents with many riches and with very much livestock, with silver and gold and copper and iron and garments in very great quantity. Take YOUR share of the spoil of YOUR enemies together with YOUR brothers.”

6435.label: Joshua 22:9
6435.text: After that the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh returned and went away from the other sons of Israel, from Shiʹloh, which is in the land of Caʹnaan, so as to go to the land of Gilʹe·ad, to the land of their possession in which they had been settled at the order of Jehovah by means of Moses.

6436.label: Joshua 22:10
6436.text: When they came to the regions of the Jordan that were in the land of Caʹnaan, then the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh built there an altar by the Jordan, an altar great in conspicuousness.

6437.label: Joshua 22:11
6437.text: Later on the other sons of Israel heard it said: “Look! The sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh have built an altar on the frontier of the land of Caʹnaan in the regions of the Jordan on the side belonging to the sons of Israel.”

6438.label: Joshua 22:12
6438.text: When the sons of Israel got to hear of it, the whole assembly of the sons of Israel were then congregated at Shiʹloh to go up for military action against them.

6439.label: Joshua 22:13
6439.text: Then the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh in the land of Gilʹe·ad Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the priest,

6440.label: Joshua 22:14
6440.text: and ten chieftains with him, one chieftain of each paternal house of all the tribes of Israel, and they were each a head of the house of their fathers of the thousands of Israel.

6441.label: Joshua 22:15
6441.text: In time they came to the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh in the land of Gilʹe·ad and began to speak with them, saying:

6442.label: Joshua 22:16
6442.text: “This is what all the assembly of Jehovah have said, ‘What is this act of unfaithfulness that YOU have perpetrated against the God of Israel in turning back today from following Jehovah by YOUR building for yourselves an altar, that YOU may rebel today against Jehovah?

6443.label: Joshua 22:17
6443.text: Was the error of Peʹor too small for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves down to this day, although the plague came to be upon the assembly of Jehovah?

6444.label: Joshua 22:18
6444.text: And YOU—YOU would turn back today from following Jehovah; and it must occur that should YOU, for YOUR part, rebel today against Jehovah, then tomorrow it will be against the entire assembly of Israel that he will be indignant.

6445.label: Joshua 22:19
6445.text: Now if it is indeed that the land of YOUR possession is unclean, make YOUR way across to the land of Jehovah’s possession where the tabernacle of Jehovah has resided, and get settled in our midst; and against Jehovah do not YOU rebel and do not make us the ones to rebel by YOUR building for yourselves an altar in addition to the altar of Jehovah our God.

6446.label: Joshua 22:20
6446.text: Was it not Aʹchan the son of Zeʹrah that perpetrated an act of unfaithfulness in the thing devoted to destruction, and was it not against all the assembly of Israel that there came indignation? And he was not the only man to expire in his error.’”

6447.label: Joshua 22:21
6447.text: At this the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh answered and spoke with the heads of the thousands of Israel:

6448.label: Joshua 22:22
6448.text: “Divine One, God, Jehovah, Divine One, God, Jehovah, he is knowing, and Israel, he too will know. If it is in rebellion and if it is in unfaithfulness against Jehovah, do not save us this day.

6449.label: Joshua 22:23
6449.text: If it was to build for ourselves an altar so as to turn back from following Jehovah, and if it was to offer up burnt offerings and grain offerings on it, and if it was to render up communion sacrifices on it, Jehovah himself will search out;

6450.label: Joshua 22:24
6450.text: or if it was not rather out of anxious care for something else that we did this, saying, ‘In a future day YOUR sons will say to our sons: “What do YOU have to do with Jehovah the God of Israel?

6451.label: Joshua 22:25
6451.text: And there is a boundary that Jehovah has put between us and YOU, the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad, namely, the Jordan. YOU have no share in Jehovah.” And YOUR sons will certainly make our sons desist from fearing Jehovah.’

6452.label: Joshua 22:26
6452.text: “Hence we said, ‘Let us take action in our behalf, please, by building the altar, not for burnt offering nor for sacrifice,

6453.label: Joshua 22:27
6453.text: but that it may be a witness between us and YOU and our generations after us that we shall render the service of Jehovah before him with our burnt offerings and our sacrifices and our communion sacrifices, that YOUR sons may not say in a future day to our sons: “YOU have no share in Jehovah.”’

6454.label: Joshua 22:28
6454.text: So we said, ‘And it must occur that in case they should say that to us and to our generations in a future day, we must also say: “See the representation of Jehovah’s altar that our fathers made, not for burnt offering nor for sacrifice, but it is a witness between us and YOU.”’

6455.label: Joshua 22:29
6455.text: It is unthinkable, on our part, to rebel of our own accord against Jehovah and to turn back today from following Jehovah by building an altar for burnt offering, grain offering and sacrifice besides the altar of Jehovah our God that is before his tabernacle!”

6456.label: Joshua 22:30
6456.text: Now when Phinʹe·has the priest and the chieftains of the assembly and the heads of the thousands of Israel who were with him heard the words that the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Ma·nasʹseh spoke, it came to be good in their eyes.

6457.label: Joshua 22:31
6457.text: So Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the priest said to the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Ma·nasʹseh: “Today we do know that Jehovah is in our midst, because YOU have not perpetrated against Jehovah this act of unfaithfulness. Now YOU have delivered the sons of Israel out of the hand of Jehovah.”

6458.label: Joshua 22:32
6458.text: With that Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the priest and the chieftains returned from the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad in the land of Gilʹe·ad to the land of Caʹnaan to the other sons of Israel and brought back word to them.

6459.label: Joshua 22:33
6459.text: And the word came to be good in the eyes of the sons of Israel; and the sons of Israel proceeded to bless God, and they did not talk of going up for army service against them to ruin the land in which the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad were dwelling.

6460.label: Joshua 22:34
6460.text: And the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad began to name the altar, because “it is a witness between us that Jehovah is the [true] God.”

6461.label: Joshua 23:1
6461.text: And it came about many days after Jehovah had given Israel rest from all their enemies all around, when Joshua was old and advanced in days,

6462.label: Joshua 23:2
6462.text: that Joshua proceeded to call all Israel, its older men and its heads and its judges and its officers, and to say to them: “As for me, I have grown old, I have advanced in days.

6463.label: Joshua 23:3
6463.text: And as for YOU, YOU have seen all that Jehovah YOUR God did to all these nations on YOUR account, because Jehovah YOUR God was the one who was fighting for YOU.

6464.label: Joshua 23:4
6464.text: See, I assigned to YOU by lot these nations that remain as an inheritance for YOUR tribes, and all the nations that I cut off, from the Jordan to the Great Sea at the setting of the sun.

6465.label: Joshua 23:5
6465.text: And Jehovah YOUR God was the one who kept pushing them away from before YOU, and he dispossessed them on YOUR account, and YOU took possession of their land, just as Jehovah YOUR God had promised YOU.

6466.label: Joshua 23:6
6466.text: “And YOU must be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses by never turning away from it to the right or to the left,

6467.label: Joshua 23:7
6467.text: by never going in among these nations, these that remain with YOU. And YOU must not mention the names of their gods nor swear by them, neither must YOU serve them nor bow down to them.

6468.label: Joshua 23:8
6468.text: But it is to Jehovah YOUR God that YOU should cleave, just as YOU have done down to this day.

6469.label: Joshua 23:9
6469.text: And Jehovah will drive away great and mighty nations from before YOU. (As for YOU, not a man has stood before YOU down to this day.)

6470.label: Joshua 23:10
6470.text: Just one man of YOU will chase a thousand, because Jehovah YOUR God is the one who is fighting for YOU, just as he has promised YOU.

6471.label: Joshua 23:11
6471.text: And YOU must be on constant guard for YOUR souls by loving Jehovah YOUR God.

6472.label: Joshua 23:12
6472.text: “But if YOU should turn back at all and YOU do cleave to what is left of these nations, these that remain with YOU, and YOU do form marriage alliances with them and go in among them, and they among YOU,

6473.label: Joshua 23:13
6473.text: YOU should positively know that Jehovah YOUR God will not continue to dispossess these nations on YOUR account; and they must become to YOU as a trap and as a snare and as a scourge on YOUR flanks and as thorns in YOUR eyes until YOU have perished off this good ground that Jehovah YOUR God has given YOU.

6474.label: Joshua 23:14
6474.text: “Now, look! I am going today in the way of all the earth, and YOU well know with all YOUR hearts and with all YOUR souls that not one word out of all the good words that Jehovah YOUR God has spoken to YOU has failed. They have all come true for YOU. Not one word of them has failed.

6475.label: Joshua 23:15
6475.text: And it must occur that, just as all the good word that Jehovah YOUR God has spoken to YOU has come upon YOU, so Jehovah will bring upon YOU all the evil word until he has annihilated YOU from off this good ground that Jehovah YOUR God has given YOU,

6476.label: Joshua 23:16
6476.text: because of YOUR overstepping the covenant of Jehovah YOUR God that he commanded YOU, and because YOU have gone and served other gods and bowed down to them. And Jehovah’s anger will certainly blaze against YOU, and YOU will certainly perish in a hurry from off the good land that he has given YOU.”

6477.label: Joshua 24:1
6477.text: And Joshua proceeded to assemble all the tribes of Israel together at Sheʹchem and to call the older men of Israel and its heads and its judges and its officers, and they went taking their stand before the [true] God.

6478.label: Joshua 24:2
6478.text: And Joshua went on to say to all the people: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘It was on the other side of the River that YOUR forefathers dwelt a long time ago, Teʹrah the father of Abraham and the father of Naʹhor, and they used to serve other gods.

6479.label: Joshua 24:3
6479.text: “‘In time I took YOUR forefather Abraham from the other side of the River and had him walk through all the land of Caʹnaan and made his seed many. So I gave him Isaac.

6480.label: Joshua 24:4
6480.text: Then to Isaac I gave Jacob and Eʹsau. Later to Eʹsau I gave Mount Seʹir to take possession of it; and Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

6481.label: Joshua 24:5
6481.text: Later on I sent Moses and Aaron, and I went plaguing Egypt with what I did in its midst; and afterward I brought YOU out.

6482.label: Joshua 24:6
6482.text: When I was bringing YOUR fathers out of Egypt and YOU came to the sea, then the Egyptians went chasing after YOUR fathers with war chariots and cavalrymen to the Red Sea.

6483.label: Joshua 24:7
6483.text: And they began to cry out to Jehovah. So he placed a darkness between YOU and the Egyptians and brought the sea upon them and covered them, and YOUR eyes got to see what I did in Egypt; and YOU took up dwelling in the wilderness many days.

6484.label: Joshua 24:8
6484.text: “‘Eventually I brought YOU to the land of the Amʹor·ites who were dwelling on the other side of the Jordan, and they went fighting against YOU. At that I gave them into YOUR hand that YOU might take possession of their land, and I annihilated them from before YOU.

6485.label: Joshua 24:9
6485.text: Then Baʹlak the son of Zipʹpor, the king of Moʹab, got up and went fighting against Israel. So he sent and summoned Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor to call down evil upon YOU.

6486.label: Joshua 24:10
6486.text: And I did not want to listen to Baʹlaam. Consequently he blessed YOU repeatedly. Thus I delivered YOU out of his hand.

6487.label: Joshua 24:11
6487.text: “‘Then YOU went crossing the Jordan and came to Jerʹi·cho. And the landowners of Jerʹi·cho, the Amʹor·ites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Caʹnaan·ites and the Hitʹtites and the Girʹga·shites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites began fighting against YOU; but I gave them into YOUR hand.

6488.label: Joshua 24:12
6488.text: So I sent the feeling of dejection ahead of YOU, and it gradually drove them out before YOU —two kings of the Amʹor·ites—not with your sword and not with your bow.

6489.label: Joshua 24:13
6489.text: Thus I gave YOU a land for which YOU had not toiled and cities that YOU had not built, and YOU took up dwelling in them. Vineyards and olive groves that YOU did not plant are what YOU are eating.’

6490.label: Joshua 24:14
6490.text: “And now fear Jehovah and serve him in faultlessness and in truth, and remove the gods that YOUR forefathers served on the other side of the River and in Egypt, and serve Jehovah.

6491.label: Joshua 24:15
6491.text: Now if it is bad in YOUR eyes to serve Jehovah, choose for yourselves today whom YOU will serve, whether the gods that YOUR forefathers who were on the other side of the River served or the gods of the Amʹor·ites in whose land YOU are dwelling. But as for me and my household, we shall serve Jehovah.”

6492.label: Joshua 24:16
6492.text: At this the people answered and said: “It is unthinkable, on our part, to leave Jehovah so as to serve other gods.

6493.label: Joshua 24:17
6493.text: For it is Jehovah our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves, and who performed these great signs before our eyes and who kept guarding us in all the way in which we walked and among all the peoples through the midst of whom we passed.

6494.label: Joshua 24:18
6494.text: And Jehovah proceeded to drive out all the peoples, even the Amʹor·ites, dwelling in the land from before us. As for us, too, we shall serve Jehovah, because he is our God.”

6495.label: Joshua 24:19
6495.text: Then Joshua said to the people: “YOU are not able to serve Jehovah, for he is a holy God; he is a God exacting exclusive devotion. He will not pardon YOUR revolting and YOUR sins.

6496.label: Joshua 24:20
6496.text: In case YOU should leave Jehovah and YOU do serve foreign gods, he also will certainly turn back and do YOU injury and exterminate YOU after he has done YOU good.”

6497.label: Joshua 24:21
6497.text: In turn the people said to Joshua: “No, but Jehovah we shall serve!”

6498.label: Joshua 24:22
6498.text: At this Joshua said to the people: “YOU are witnesses against yourselves that YOU of YOUR own accord have chosen Jehovah for yourselves, to serve him.” To this they said: “We are witnesses.”

6499.label: Joshua 24:23
6499.text: “And now remove the foreign gods that are among YOU, and incline YOUR hearts to Jehovah the God of Israel.”

6500.label: Joshua 24:24
6500.text: In turn the people said to Joshua: “Jehovah our God we shall serve, and to his voice we shall listen!”

6501.label: Joshua 24:25
6501.text: And Joshua proceeded to conclude a covenant with the people on that day and to constitute for them a regulation and judicial decision in Sheʹchem.

6502.label: Joshua 24:26
6502.text: Then Joshua wrote these words in the book of God’s law and took a great stone and set it up there under the massive tree that is by the sanctuary of Jehovah.

6503.label: Joshua 24:27
6503.text: And Joshua went on to say to all the people: “Look! This stone is what will serve as a witness against us, because it has itself heard all the sayings of Jehovah that he has spoken with us, and it must serve as a witness against YOU, that YOU may not deny YOUR God.”

6504.label: Joshua 24:28
6504.text: With that Joshua sent the people away, each one to his inheritance.

6505.label: Joshua 24:29
6505.text: And it came about that after these things Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, gradually died at the age of a hundred and ten years.

6506.label: Joshua 24:30
6506.text: So they buried him in the territory of his inheritance in Timʹnath-seʹrah, which is in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, north of Mount Gaʹash.

6507.label: Joshua 24:31
6507.text: And Israel continued to serve Jehovah all the days of Joshua and all the days of the older men who extended their days after Joshua and who had known all the work of Jehovah that he did for Israel.

6508.label: Joshua 24:32
6508.text: And Joseph’s bones, which the sons of Israel had brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Sheʹchem in the tract of the field that Jacob had acquired from the sons of Haʹmor, Sheʹchem’s father, for a hundred pieces of money; and it came to belong to the sons of Joseph as an inheritance.

6509.label: Joshua 24:33
6509.text: Also, El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron died. So they buried him in the Hill of Phinʹe·has his son, which he had given him in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im.
